1902960.short_description: Embark on a new narrative journey by the creators of Life is Strange. Film your summer of 1995 and create memories of a lifetime with your new friends. 27 years later, confront the dark secrets that made you all promise to never speak again after that fateful summer.

2776940.name: Echoes of Yi : Samsara
2776940.short_description: ECHOES of YI: SAMSARA is a dark martial arts action game infused with traditional Chinese culture. Players embody the Sword Saint's first disciple, battling fierce enemies and unraveling the mystery beneath the Jianmu Tree. Will you face the challenges or go with the flow? The choice is yours.

3299920.name: Liminal Point
3299920.short_description: Classic Survival Horror. Drawn to Ashen Point by a cryptic voicemail, Lyra returns to the island where her band’s story ended in tragedy. Shrouded in fog and prowled by horrors, confront deadly creatures, explore the desolate town, and reveal the truth behind the night that changed everything.

2486820.name: Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds
2486820.short_description: Race across land, sea, air, space, and time in Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds! Warp through Travel Rings into new dimensions where something new awaits around every twist and turn.

3292470.name: Tides of Annihilation
3292470.short_description: Tides of Annihilation is an action-adventure game steeped in the legends of King Arthur. When an otherworldly invasion shatters London, Gwendolyn, a lone survivor, embarks on a desperate quest to fight back and uncover the truth that lies beyond the veil.

1620730.name: Hell is Us
1620730.short_description: If war is the closest we get to hell on earth, it's because Earth harbours the worst of demons: humankind. In an isolated country ravaged by infighting, discover the secrets of your past and deal with the repercussions of a mysterious calamity.

3244220.name: A Game About Digging A Hole™
3244220.short_description: A minimalist game about digging a hole in the garden of a newly purchased house. Collect resources, sell them, upgrade your equipment and discover a mysterious secret. Costs you only one coffee!

1820140.name: SlavicPunk: Oldtimer
1820140.short_description: The game is an isometric shooter. The story revolves around Yanus- a private investigator with a troubled past trying to solve the case of stolen data while fighting his inner demons, urban gangs and an omnipotent corporation responsible for the decay of the city he once used to call his own.

2412960.name: Breathedge 2
2412960.short_description: Survive on the edge of space! Craft and upgrade tools, scavenge resources, and save a galaxy gone completely off the rails. Can Ordinary Man save the galaxy with the help of the immortal Chicken and some duct tape?

2075100.name: Chernobylite 2: Exclusion Zone
2075100.short_description: Explore the mysterious, beautiful, yet dark world of the Chornobyl Exclusion Zone in this post-apocalyptic action-RPG. Make your mark on this world, through your character development, choices and playstyle. But remember – everything has a price and consequences.

3300410.name: Garten of Banban 0
3300410.short_description: Explore the origins of the mysterious Banban’s Kindergarten. Survive the dark past of the establishment. Try to make some friends. Uncover the truth behind the place, and who you are…

1951780.name: Jumping Jazz Cats
1951780.short_description: Play, race and hang with your feline friends in this online platformer party game! Purrfect your pussycat parkour as you sprint, jump, bounce, swing, skid and slide through a collection of collaborative and competitive mini-games set in a grandiose cartoon mansion. Get jumpin', jazz cats!

1373910.name: Anvil Empires
1373910.short_description: Anvil is a massively multiplayer game where thousands of players work together to build empires, wage war, and conquer in a persistent online world. March alongside armies of players in massive melee battles and large scale sieges.

1805110.name: Solarpunk™
1805110.short_description: Solarpunk is a survival game in a technologically advanced world of floating islands. Alone or together with your friends, you can construct buildings, grow food, craft gadgets and hop on your airship to explore distant islands in the sky.

3077390.name: MotoGP™25
3077390.short_description: Rev up your engines for the 2025 season! Feel the authentic MotoGP™ thrills with refined sound design and exciting challenges. Train with new disciplines in Race Off mode and choose the Arcade or Pro Experience for ultimate fun or realism!

3075410.name: Hand of Fate: Hordes
3075410.short_description: Control powerful heroes and carve your way through dungeons, quests, and endless monsters and bosses. Grow your powers every run with new weapons and enchantments. Choose your cards wisely and thrive in chaos.

3111080.name: Secret Agent Wizard Boy
3111080.short_description: You’re a wizard! And a secret agent. The evil S.P.I.D.E.R crime syndicate has taken over your school, creating chaos. Play solo or up to 4 player co-op as you duel students, discover ancient secrets, and use scandalous spells.

3527760.name: RoboCop: Rogue City - Unfinished Business
3527760.short_description: Unfinished Business is a new standalone adventure of RoboCop: Rogue City. OmniTower is their fortress, violence their language. Face elite mercenaries all the way to the top of the tower and enforce the law amidst the chaos!

3290690.name: Styx: Blades of Greed
3290690.short_description: The master of stealth is back! Explore the dizzying heights of the Iserian Continent and cunningly eliminate your enemies. Thanks to your Quartz powers, you are freer than ever. Be creative: Never has it felt so good to be greedy.

2760560.name: Cthulhu: The Cosmic Abyss
2760560.short_description: A mining station in the Pacific abyss is no longer responding. As an investigator of the occult, unravel the mysteries of the deep. Test your wits and sanity in this lovecraftian thriller.

3144860.name: WILL: Follow The Light
3144860.short_description: Dive into a realistic, single-player, first-person journey through the harsh northern latitudes as you sail endless waters, searching for a way back to your loved ones. Will you follow the light?

1374320.name: Regeneration
1374320.short_description: Regeneration is a psychological horror about a scientist trapped in an anomalous wilderness, where shifting reality blurs the line between self and something inhuman. Escape the nightmare before your mind is completely consumed.

2581410.name: Stygian: Outer Gods
2581410.short_description: Dive into a hostile world that challenges your very existence, in this survival horror game with RPG elements. Unravel a thousand-year-old mystery, risk your sanity and face the Outer Gods with your skills. Every bullet and every decision counts now, are you up to the task?

2141730.name: Backrooms: Escape Together
2141730.short_description: A visually lifelike co-op horror game for 1-6 people. Journey through 11 procedurally generated levels, using what's available to survive and progress deeper into the Backrooms.

458430.name: Steel Seed
458430.short_description: Steel Seed is a stealth-action adventure set in a dark sci-fi world on the brink of extinction. Play as Zoe and her drone Koby as they explore a hostile underground facility. Uncover secrets, survive dangers, search for answers, and humanity’s last hope.

2947440.name: SILENT HILL f
2947440.short_description: Hinako's hometown is engulfed in fog, driving her to fight grotesque monsters and solve eerie puzzles. Uncover the disturbing beauty hidden in terror.

2989180.name: Darwin's Paradox!
2989180.short_description: Step into a cinematic adventure as Darwin, a brilliant octopus trapped in a mysterious industrial world. Use his unique abilities - swimming, wall-climbing, shooting ink, camouflage, and more - to overcome traps and escape.

2987540.name: BAN: The Prologue of GUCHA GUCHA
2987540.short_description: 【A richly coloured horror and mystery tale】BAN: The Prologue of GUCHA GUCHA is a third-person horror adventure game. Experience the messy horror from the perspective of the protagonist, who is caught up in the whirlwind of events in a certain town in Japan, Utagacho.

3263320.name: Carry The Glass
3263320.short_description: Team up as two quirky construction workers in this fun 2-player co-op platformer! Carry a fragile glass window through colorful levels filled with challenges. Communicate and coordinate to dodge obstacles and solve puzzles. Can you finish the job without breaking the glass?

2113850.name: Spirit City: Lofi Sessions
2113850.short_description: Spirit City: Lofi Sessions is a gamified focus tool, set to a soothing lofi soundtrack. Discover and collect Spirits, customize your cozy virtual space, and facilitate your real-life tasks with a collection of handy features designed to improve concentration and ease stress.

3059070.name: The Headliners
3059070.short_description: Co-op horror game where you play in teams of 1 to 8 reckless journalists, ready to explore a city overrun by deadly creatures to snap spectacular footage. Your only goal: make the headlines without becoming one.

2963880.name: Murky Divers
2963880.short_description: Solo or up to 8 players. Get rid of your employer's failed experiments in abandoned underwater labs. Navigate your submarine, avoid abyssal terrors, and remove all corpses.

1299290.name: Somber Echoes
1299290.short_description: Armed with God-given powers, the revived tribune Adrestia is given a second chance to save the universe from her maniacal twin sister. Find secrets, acquire upgrades, and dominate mighty foes through sheer combat prowess as you explore and conquer the horrors of the forsaken vessel Atromitos.

2378910.name: Settlements Rising
2378910.short_description: Settlements Rising is a medieval city building and colony management game. It offers a lively colony experience with simulated villagers, dozens of professions and resources, natural disasters, and raids, while providing full control over the colony through trade, production chains and datas.

3183280.name: Game of Thrones: Kingsroad
3183280.short_description: A story-driven action-adventure RPG, bringing the world of Westeros to life with remarkable detail and never-before seen scale.

2070270.name: Cloudheim
2070270.short_description: Master chaotic physics-based combat inspired by Zelda and Devil May Cry. Explore islands and dungeons, smash monsters, loot and craft powerful gear, and grow your home in the sky. Play solo or online co-op with up to 4 players.

2995560.name: Wildkeepers Rising
2995560.short_description: Tame monsters! Slay waves of enemy hordes! Explore fantasy lands! Wildkeepers Rising is a whimsical action-RPG roguelite set in a beautiful hand-drawn world that combines the power curve of bullet heaven games with the compulsive fun of a creature collector.

2464530.name: VOIN
2464530.short_description: Crafted by a solo developer, VOIN is a first-person hack-and-slash. Cleave through hordes of enemies in fast-paced combat. Explore dark fantasy realms filled with secrets and dangers. Discover powerful gear and weapons, and face menacing bosses in your quest to cleanse a broken world.

2682580.name: DUCKSIDE
2682580.short_description: Imagine DayZ or Rust but you're a duck. A persistent world survival game with PVP, PVE, crafting, base building and hat wearing ducks, wielding weapons.

1456940.name: Level Zero: Extraction
1456940.short_description: Tactical extraction shooter meets immersive survival horror. Play as rival mercenaries fighting for loot, or as alien monsters hunting humans from the shadows. Solo or with friends, experience this unique dark take on asymmetrical PvPvE multiplayer.

2357000.name: KILL IT WITH FIRE! 2
2357000.short_description: KILL IT WITH FIRE! 2 is the ultimate co-op spider-hunting experience! Either solo or as a team of Exterminators, unleash an arsenal of crazy weapons, wreak havoc, and complete dozens of challenges across seven dimensions under spider siege.

2804680.name: Only Way is Down
2804680.short_description: Embark on a purrfectly perilous rage filled adventure as this lil kitty cat took an unfortunate catnap and ended up stranded sky high! With no way but down, master your feline agility and platforming prowess to navigate your descent through the urban jungle in this gravity defying escapade!

1206410.name: Kristala
1206410.short_description: Kristala is a dark fantasy ARPG featuring challenging combat, fluid parkour, and deep exploration. Master the ancient magic of the Sacred Kristals and uncover the source of a mysterious curse in a thrilling, story-driven adventure.

2222540.name: BIT.TRIP RERUNNER
2222540.short_description: The classic rhythm platformer is back as BIT.TRIP RERUNNER + RUNNER MAKER! The fun of the original now sports fresh mechanics, art, and soundtrack – plus RUNNER MAKER, which allows you to create custom levels. A must-play for rhythm newbies, experts, and everyone in between.

2697930.name: Commander Quest
2697930.short_description: Congratulations! You just found a 'one of a kind' roguelike that combines deck-building card game and auto battle strategy game! Consider unit counters, then create powerful synergy by breaking down the boundaries between the battlefield and cards, then lead your army to victory!

2794830.name: Cinnabunny
2794830.short_description: Cinnabunny is a cozy life simulator game where you play as a bunny who runs a bakery. Unlock new recipes, go birdwatching, collect mushrooms, and charm your community. Save up enough carrots to help your family move.

990380.name: METAL EDEN
990380.short_description: An adrenaline-rush sci-fi FPS. A HYPER UNIT ASKA is sent on a suicide mission to rescue citizens' COREs from MOEBIUS, an orbital city turned into a deadly trap. Dive into cybernetic warfare, face the ENGINEERS, and uncover the secrets of METAL EDEN.

2467810.name: Orebound
2467810.short_description: Orebound is a dwarven themed factory automation game. Play alone or with friends as you build, mine, craft and explore a voxel generated world! Build your fortress, expand your factory, fight off creatures who dwell beneath the mountains and embark on a journey of greatness.

3183730.name: Driveloop: Survivors
3183730.short_description: Driveloop is a fast-paced driving roguelike shooter. Drift, blast and ram your way through waves of steampunk enemies. Upgrade your vehicle with powerful weapons, recruit unique crew members and survive intense battles as you build the ultimate combat machine. Can you survive the chaos?

3374460.name: Causal Loop
3374460.short_description: Causal Loop is a narrative puzzler that blends mind-bending mechanics with a rich sci-fi story about time, consequence, and survival. Solve intricate puzzles by using the signature “echo” mechanic to record, replay, and interact with up to three versions of your past self. Can you break the loop?

2569760.name: The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu
2569760.short_description: In up to four player co-op, form a group of explorers searching for treasure. In this cursed jungle, danger is everywhere and monstrous creatures alter reality. Stay clear-headed and tame the jungle before it devours you…

2344320.name: Eldegarde
2344320.short_description: Eldegarde is a mini-MMO Action RPG with PvE, PvPvE and Arena modes. Explore vast outdoor zones, craft powerful gear, and fight to survive in a living fantasy world.

1879940.name: Dark Mass
1879940.short_description: Dark Mass is a fully underwater horror game. Explore the ruins of a sunken manor and flee from a curse trapped within for centuries. Your choices will decide if you escape or join the lost souls of the abyss.

1153410.name: JDM: Japanese Drift Master
1153410.short_description: Discover Japan’s legendary car culture in JDM! Take on challenging mountain roads, visit Japanese legendary drifting spots in licensed JDM cars and immerse in the story about second chances told through manga pages. Explore an open world where every turn invites you to master the art of drift.

3351550.name: Alien Grounds
3351550.short_description: Single-player arena shooter. Weird weapons. Relentless robots. Easy to play, hard to score. Enter the chaos, shoot the bots, and compete in the Monthly Challenge.

1374490.name: RuneScape: Dragonwilds
1374490.short_description: On RuneScape's forgotten continent of Ashenfall, dragons have awoken. Gather, build, skill and craft in this co-operative survival adventure. Only by mastering survival and uncovering ancient secrets can you hope to face the ferocious Dragon Queen.

2623190.name: The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion Remastered
2623190.short_description: Explore Cyrodiil like never before with stunning new visuals and refined gameplay in The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion™ Remastered.

2787320.name: Revenge of the Savage Planet
2787320.short_description: Revenge of the Savage Planet is an upbeat, satirical action adventure Sci-Fi. Jump, shoot and collect your way across vibrant alien worlds, uncovering new gear and upgrades, while discovering various hidden secrets.

2067350.name: Phantom Breaker: Battle Grounds Ultimate
2067350.short_description: "Phantom Breaker: Battle Grounds Ultimate" is a side-scrolling beat-'em-up with the heart of a fighting game, showcasing nostalgic pixel art and the latest cross-platform online multiplayer. Experience the biggest and most expansive entry in the "Phantom Breaker: Battle Grounds" series to date!

3265250.name: MindsEye
3265250.short_description: MindsEye is an ever-expanding gameplay experience with a story campaign, endless stream of new playable content delivered regularly, and the power to create your own games with our simple to use building tool.

3333990.name: Covenant
3333990.short_description: Covenant is a first-person dark fantasy combat game in which you play as a messenger sent from above. Wield martial arts, secret magic, and ancient weapons to explore a vast interconnected world.

2075800.name: STAR WARS Zero Company™
2075800.short_description: Command an elite squad through a gritty and authentic story in STAR WARS Zero Company™, a single-player turn-based tactics game set in the twilight of the Clone Wars™.

3554930.name: The Bright Path
3554930.short_description: "The bright path" is a 45 minutes long educational interactive computer game for Windows which you can use to familiarize yourselves or other unexperienced youngsters with the topics of dangers of drug abuse, addiction and active citizenships in your communities.

3645160.name: Frostpunk: 1886
3645160.short_description: A full reimagining of Frostpunk, the groundbreaking survival city builder, packed with new content. In a world ravaged by endless frost, become the Captain of the last city on Earth. Manage its people and infrastructure while facing cruel weather and even crueler choices.

3316350.name: Flesh Made Fear
3316350.short_description: Tank controls. Fixed cameras. Pure Terror. Set in a haunting world of twisted experiments and occult nightmares, this game brings back the survival horror mechanics you know and love while pushing the genre into terrifying new depths.

3316090.name: The Third Pig
3316090.short_description: After your brothers are killed by Mr. Wolf and a mysterious associate you wake up to find yourself trapped in your own home and must use your wits and determination to escape. Do you have what it takes to escape?

2863640.name: The Midnight Walk
2863640.short_description: Follow The Midnight Walk in a dark adventure from the minds behind Lost in Random. Befriend a lost lantern creature and light your way through a world of wonder and terror. Outsmart monsters and marvel at details in a landscape handcrafted with real clay and animated in a stop motion style.

2526310.name: Out of Sight
2526310.short_description: You’re Sophie, a young blind girl who sees through her teddy bear’s eyes. Escape your captors and uncover the evil history of the dark mansion you desperately seek to escape in this unique, atmospheric horror puzzle/adventure game.

3655390.name: Alien: Rogue Incursion Evolved Edition
3655390.short_description: A new action-horror story set in the iconic Alien universe. Play as rogue Colonial Marine Zula Hendricks, sent to investigate a blacksite on Purdan. Fight and survive using your skill, reflexes, and determination against a deadly Xenomorph incursion in this gripping first chapter of a two-part saga.

2488370.name: Cash Cleaner Simulator
2488370.short_description: Check it, clean it, sort it, ship it. Welcome to the life of a cash cleaner. Take jobs from underworld contacts and clean some cash. Just don't try to leave...

750130.name: The Sinking City Remastered
750130.short_description: Powered by Unreal Engine 5, The Sinking City Remastered brings the eerie, atmospheric world of Oakmont back to life with enhanced gameplay and fully relit environments, perfect for both newcomers and returning players.

2830030.name: MOTORSLICE
2830030.short_description: Parkour through the ruins of a megastructure, climb massive bosses, and hunt down every construction equipment in this slice of life action-adventure with immaculate vibes.

3500810.name: DreadOut 3
3500810.short_description: DreadOut 3 is a third-person horror adventure inspired by Asian - Indonesian urban legend. Follow Linda’s journey as a Keeper of the Dark into an interdimensional rabbit hole to find the source of unseen power threatening the balance of light and darkness.

2993780.name: FANTASY LIFE i: The Girl Who Steals Time
2993780.short_description: Step into this Slow-Life RPG where you can freely switch between 14 unique jobs, so called "Lives," and enjoy a carefree life in a fantasy world. Fish, cook, shape the island to your liking, or team up with friends to battle monsters across the vast world.

3115160.name: Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2
3115160.short_description: Obliterate heretics in the name of the Emperor in Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2! Play as Ultramarine Malum Caedo or Sister of Battle Nyra Veyrath in this sequel to retro FPS Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun with MORE enemies, MORE weapons, and NEW ways to purge!

1875320.name: to a T
1875320.short_description: A charming, colorful adventure game from the creator of Katamari Damacy and the uvula team about a teen navigating life in a small town with their cute dog companion. While their body is stuck in a T-pose, they do their best to make the most of it.

2377280.name: Eriksholm: The Stolen Dream
2377280.short_description: Experience an isometric, narrative-driven stealth game and join Hanna’s adventure in the vibrant city of Eriksholm. The mysterious disappearance of her brother, Herman, ignites a chain of catastrophic events that will forever change their lives and the fate of the entire city.

1817800.name: Oddsparks: An Automation Adventure
1817800.short_description: Oddsparks is a blend of automation and real-time strategy for both the die-hard fans of the automation genre and the automation-curious. Explore a strange fantasy world, uncover the mysteries of the past, automate your workshops, and go on adventures with your odd & adorable Sparks!

2078450.name: Warhammer 40,000: Speed Freeks
2078450.short_description: High-orktane combat racing in the Warhammer 40,000 universe! Drive buggies, tanks and helicopters, mastering advanced movement and explosive weaponry online or against bots. Unlock gear, customize your rides and use the NEW Creation Workshop to create, share, and play custom maps from the community!

2615540.name: VOID/BREAKER
2615540.short_description: Fast paced Bullet hell Roguelite FPS 🔴 Fight relentless machines driven by a hostile AI. Escape an endless cycle. Craft infinite weapon variants with deep gun modding. Forge deadly synergies. Carve your way out through enviro destruction /BREAK THE SYSTEM /BREAK FREE

2864560.name: Rune Factory: Guardians of Azuma
2864560.short_description: Welcome to the eastern nation of Azuma! In this fresh take on Rune Factory, use your powers as an Earth Dancer to restore the land, its people, and even its gods. Along the way, battle corrupted monsters, rebuild seasonal farms and villages, and form bonds with the colorful locals.

3135840.name: Hirogami
developers: Bandai Namco Studios Singapore Pte. Ltd.
Bandai Namco Studios Malaysia Sdn. Bhd.
3135840.short_description: Explore a beautiful origami world as Hiro, a fan-wielding master of the art of ‘folding’. Embark on a mystical journey to save your fragile home from deadly digital invaders. Take on animal forms to traverse the landscape, solve puzzles, overcome enemies, and save the realm.

2584270.name: Mortal Shell II
2584270.short_description: Their Flesh Is Your Weapon. Mortal Shell II is a standalone sequel action-RPG with adrenaline-charged, high-stakes combat. Possess warrior Shells, dethrone false gods, redeem a ravaged world.

3788800.name: Atomic Heart 2
3788800.short_description: The Atomic Heart sequel brings you back to the retrofuturistic universe, full of new characters and dangers. The game immerses you in events on a global scale and raises the bar for what an open-world action RPG can do.

2873440.name: Chrono Odyssey
2873440.short_description: Chrono Odyssey, A Next-generation Action MMORPG. Game features include awe-inspiring visuals powered by Unreal Engine 5, a vast and intricately designed seamless open world, dynamic action-based combat mechanics based on time manipulation and extensive customization.

1757350.name: ILL
1757350.short_description: A realistic first-person action horror game that takes you into a dark fort overtaken by a mysterious entity. Unpredictable monsters, a visceral dismemberment system, and realistic physics create an atmosphere of relentless terror.

2231020.name: Chronicles: Medieval
2231020.short_description: Step into a vast, dynamic medieval sandbox set in the age of the Hundred Years' War. Explore a brutal but beautiful, historically grounded Europe, command armies in massive battles, leave a mark the chroniclers can't ignore as you make your name one fight at a time. What story will you write?

2362060.name: CODE VEIN II
2362060.short_description: An epic adventure awaits, where you and your chosen partners explore a post-apocalyptic world, face fierce battles against powerful enemies, and uncover an epic story that transcends time.

3763840.name: Felt That: Boxing
3763840.short_description: Felt That: Boxing is a comedic boxing game set in a world where the charm of furry puppets collides with the fury of boxing. Step into the shoes of Ezra "Fuzz-E" Wright, an unlikely hero with a big heart. His quest? Battle his way through the Tournament of a Million Punches to save an orphanage!

3727390.name: The Expanse: Osiris Reborn
3727390.short_description: The Expanse: Osiris Reborn is a third-person Action RPG set in The Expanse universe. You’re no hero — just a merc caught in the wrong place at the wrong time, trying to hold your crew together and keep the ship up and running. Your choices will shape your story.

2821610.name: Echoes of the End: Enhanced Edition
2821610.short_description: Embark on a perilous journey to rescue your brother and prevent a looming war. Harness the power of devastating magical abilities to conquer enemies, traverse treacherous landscapes, and unveil the hidden history of Aema.

2383240.name: Ecumene Aztec
2383240.short_description: Ecumene Aztec is a brutal action-adventure game with stealth elements, set in the time of the Aztecs. Take on the role of a fugitive who has escaped being sacrificed. Fight, climb and survive in a dark and bloody world. Decide which side of the conflict you will take...

1966410.name: Aphelion
1966410.short_description: Hunted on a frozen planet, astronaut Ariane must brave rugged landscapes and shifting realities to rescue her wounded partner, Thomas. This action-packed sci-fi adventure blends exploration, traversal, and tense stealth gameplay.

1790930.name: Crisol: Theater of Idols
1790930.short_description: Crisol is a survival horror adventure set in a twisted version of Spain. As a soldier captured by religious dogmatism, you must use your own blood as ammunition, without draining to the point of death. Explore the cursed island of Tormentosa, uncover dark secrets, and battle horrifying enemies.

2069250.name: High On Life 2
2069250.short_description: An intergalactic conspiracy threatens the fate of humanity! Team up with a wide cast of talking alien guns as you shoot, stab, and skate your way through the exotic locales to take down the bad guys and save your favorite species (humans)!

3043580.name: Keeper
3043580.short_description: From Lee Petty and Double Fine Productions, Keeper is an atmospheric puzzle adventure in which a long-forgotten lighthouse is awakened and, joined by a spirited seabird, it embarks upon a heartening tale of unlikely companionship, and an unexpected journey into realms beyond understanding

3051490.name: Nicktoons & The Dice of Destiny
3051490.short_description: Bring iconic Nickelodeon heroes into a world of fantasy and real-time RPG action. Throw the dice and dive into a wild, action-packed adventure with SpongeBob, Katara, Leonardo, and others. Featuring epic battles, dynamic environments, it's an engaging gameplay experience for players of all ages.

2174380.name: Call of the Elder Gods
2174380.short_description: Journey to the far corners of the Earth and unearth ancient horrors in this Lovecraftian narrative puzzle adventure and sequel to 2020’s critically acclaimed Call of the Sea.

2661300.name: Grounded 2
2661300.short_description: Shrunk again, but the world is much larger. In this open-world, single-player or co-op survival adventure, craft weapons and armor, build your base, and traverse the playground on your buggy. But something else is out there—and it hasn’t forgotten you.

2953480.name: Lunar Eclipse
2953480.short_description: Explore dark locations, solve puzzles, and uncover a gripping story. Fight or evade bloodthirsty zombies using wit and agility. Immerse yourself in a tense adventure with a charming blonde heroine in a chilling, atmospheric world.

2525310.name: Drop Duchy
2525310.short_description: Build your duchy piece by piece in this refreshing hybrid rogue-lite game. Use block-dropping mechanics to collect resources, recruit troops to fight against belligerent armies, and let every block shape your realm, leading your path to victory!

2986450.name: Metro Gravity
2986450.short_description: Explore, fight, solve puzzles and bend gravity to escape the dream-like world of the Halls! Metro Gravity is a mind-boggling musical adventure with rhythmic combat and compelling lore.

2055590.name: Star Overdrive
2055590.short_description: Star Overdrive is a high-speed action adventure set in an open world. Race across an alien planet on your Hoverboard, mastering tricks, battling enemies, solving puzzles, and using your powers to overcome challenges and shape your destiny!

3288210.name: Super Meat Boy 3D
3288210.short_description: The infamous, tough-as-nails platformer – now in 3D!

3787240.name: MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls
3787240.short_description: Assemble your team of legendary Marvel characters in the ultimate 4v4 tag team fighter.

3566840.name: Bleak Haven
3566840.short_description: Bleak Haven is a cinematic survival horror where faith is twisted, every shot matters, and survival hangs on what you can build. Explore haunted ruins, abandoned villages, and face a cult preparing the world for a god no one should ever witness.

2889030.name: MUDANG: Two Hearts
2889030.short_description: In a unified Korea, masked terrorists strike at the heart of Seoul. Ji Jeongtae, a soldier sent in to stop the attacks, stumbles upon a K-Pop star named Gavi at the center of the unfolding crisis. As their stories intertwine, a chilling truth begins to take shape.

2340130.name: Ground Zero
2340130.short_description: Fight through post-apocalyptic South Korea in this retro survival horror. Uncover the truth behind the devastating meteor impact that left the country in ruins and turned every living organism into a terrifying monstrosity. Fight. Solve puzzles. Upgrade gear. Make every bullet count.

2469330.name: The Pirate Queen with Lucy Liu
2469330.short_description: The Pirate Queen is an Emmy-nominated narrative adventure starring Lucy Liu. Climb aboard a 19th century Chinese pirate ship, explore moonlit cabins, unearth treasure and embark on a journey to become the most powerful pirate of all time. Do you have what it takes to be crowned The Pirate Queen?

2001760.name: Beast of Reincarnation
2001760.short_description: Game Freak's brand-new title: Beast of Reincarnation is an action RPG with a fusion of real-time and turn-based combat. Experience the innovative "one-person, one-dog action RPG" in the beautiful yet harsh world of Beast of Reincarnation. What awaits at the end of Emma and Koo's journey?

3323210.name: The Age of Bhaarat
3323210.short_description: The Age of Bhaarat is a dark fantasy action-adventure game that brings ancient India to life. Become a powerful Forest Warden, master mystical weapons and arcane powers, and defend your homeland against a devastating invasion by vicious demons, the Rakshasas.

3218100.name: I AM RIPPER
3218100.short_description: I AM RIPPER is a British Thriller set in the brutality and economic decline of the 1980's. You are a forensic investigator called on to solve one of the UK's most prolific crimes.

3352690.name: Dead Take
3352690.short_description: Find your missing friend. Uncover the secrets within. Brave a luxurious and haunting mansion in Dead Take, a first-person psychological horror crafted by Surgent Studios.

2424010.name: Parcel Simulator
2424010.short_description: Inspect and process parcels and packages in this parcel inspection simulator! Receive and sort deliveries, examine labels for mistakes, and automate to maximise warehouse efficiency. Upgrade and expand your warehouse to build your parcel empire!

1774880.name: Blight: Survival
1774880.short_description: Blight: Survival is a PvE Action-Horror Game set in a brutal medieval world. Play in solo or team-up with up to 3 friends as you face monsters and men in a tense battle for survival. How far are you willing to go?

1987400.name: Death Relives
1987400.short_description: Get ready to see life through the eyes of a young man trying to escape Xipe Totec an ancient deity venerated across Mesoamerican civilizations and later embraced by the Aztecs. A chaotic experience full of horror and survival mechanics awaits.

3401920.name: Upin & Ipin Universe
3401920.short_description: Explore the vibrant world of Upin & Ipin Universe an open-world adventure inspired by kampung life, full of local charm, culture, and heartwarming stories from Malaysia.

2434440.name: King of Silence - Prologue
2434440.short_description: Embark on a chilling journey in King of Silence, a first-person horror game where silence is survival. Trapped in a dark, abandoned temple, you must quietly uncover its secrets and the eerie legend of the King of Silence to find your escape. Make a sound, and it may be your last.

2941710.name: Project Silverfish
2941710.short_description: Explore a hostile, living world: Uncover forgotten horrors, both man-made and supernatural, as you hunt for powerful weapons and exotic artifacts.

1546080.name: Every Day We Fight
1546080.short_description: Turn-based tactics meets real-time choices. Control each moment of combat: react to enemy fire, aim your shots, and interrupt enemies on-the-fly. Transform a trio of ragtag civilians into seasoned soldiers - and escape the alien timeloop.

3325070.name: Forest Reigns
3325070.short_description: Forest Reigns is an emergent FPS set in post-apocalyptic Paris overrun by an evolving forest and its deadly creatures. Adapt to use the ever-changing environment in your favor. Modify your guns, bond with factions and explore the world freely. Your choices will shape the story.

3015650.name: Chrono
3015650.short_description: Chrono is a puzzle/platformer game where you control how time affects objects in the world. By freezing time, fast-forwarding, or rewinding objects, you can crack a wide variety of puzzles. The goal is to escape the facility where you are trapped, before time runs out.

2679830.name: Crowned In Steel
2679830.short_description: Crush, stab, slice, rend, break, maim and decapitate your enemies in a skill-based action-adventure with brutal combat and full dismemberment.

1729740.name: Luto
1729740.short_description: Luto is a psychological horror experience where you take on the role of someone unable to leave their home. Every attempt to escape will lead you deeper into the unknown, where nothing is as it seems and everything will test your senses.

3107020.name: Shadows of The Lost
3107020.short_description: Shadows of the Lost is a mythological dark fantasy action RPG where the corrupting power of shadow is wielded to defy twisted gods, navigating a grim world torn apart by betrayal, corruption, and shattered myths.

1691280.name: Maximum Football
1691280.short_description: Forge your legacy in Maximum Football, where you can play both college and pro football in one shared universe. Recruit the next college superstar and take them into the pros to become a future Hall of Famer. Build your team with unparalleled in-game customization that gives you ultimate control.

2019760.name: Necrophosis
2019760.short_description: Necrophosis is a first-person horror adventure, plunging you into a nightmarish realm teeming with grotesque forms and ominous visuals. Delve into eerie landscapes and uncover secrets in this atmospheric journey through the macabre.

2453160.name: Sword of the Sea
2453160.short_description: Surf across magnificent waves of sand and glistening waters on an epic quest to restore a lost ocean. From the visionary artist behind ABZÛ, The Pathless, and Journey, Sword of the Sea is an atmospheric surfing adventure with fast movement inspired by classic skateboarding and snowboarding games.

2582320.name: Mixtape
2582320.short_description: On their last night together, three friends embark on one final adventure. Play through a mixtape of memories, set to the soundtrack of a generation.

1551980.name: Clive Barker's Hellraiser: Revival
1551980.short_description: Experience a new chapter in the legendary horror series like never before. Clive Barker's Hellraiser: Revival takes first-person action horror survival to the next level. Wield the powers of the Genesis Configuration puzzle box to survive your bargain with the infamous Pinhead.

3504780.name: Wildgate
3504780.short_description: Wildgate is a PvPvE multiplayer shooter that blends tactical ship-to-ship combat with fast-paced first-person action. Evade deadly environmental hazards, search for powerful weapons and ship upgrades, and be the first crew to escape with the Artifact... or the last crew left flying.

3419520.name: Quarantine Zone: The Last Check
3419520.short_description: Command the checkpoint in a collapsing city. Screen survivors, manage scarce resources, and hold back the undead. Every choice matters and one mistake could unleash the plague beyond your walls. FREE CONTENT UPDATE AVAILABLE NOW

1313290.name: Let Them Trade
1313290.short_description: Build a network of cities that produce and trade resources, upgrade your castle, and protect the cities from cheeky bandits. Tinker with the economy at your own pace, and watch the charming wooden world grow into a lively and thriving kingdom.

1203170.name: Darksiders 4
1203170.short_description: The legendary saga of the Four Horsemen continues in Darksiders 4, an all-new action-adventure set in an apocalyptic version of earth and continues where the original Darksiders game left off.

2977260.name: The Guild 1 Remake: Europa 1410
2977260.short_description: Choose from professions like Smith, Preacher or Alchemist to gain riches in this medieval economic simulation. Climb the social ladder, dominate politics, and lead your dynasty to power over multiple generations to ensure your legacy.

2186990.name: Fatekeeper
2186990.short_description: Venture into a handcrafted world where ruins whisper of past cataclysms. Master the art of sword and sorcery and forge your path with relics, spells and choices that shape who you become in this first-person RPG.

2479650.name: SpongeBob SquarePants: Titans of the Tide
2479650.short_description: Prepare to be scared! A clash between the Flying Dutchman and King Neptune has unleashed ghostly mayhem all over Bikini Bottom. Switch seamlessly between SpongeBob and Patrick, combine their unique skills and save Bikini Bottom from total ghostification!

2678080.name: Tides of Tomorrow 🌊
2678080.short_description: From the creators of Road 96 comes a groundbreaking solo narrative adventure where other players’ choices matter. Follow in your friends’ footsteps, face the consequences of their actions, and decide the fate of a plasticpunk world.

2903560.name: Platform 8
2903560.short_description: You are trapped on a train that runs forever. Keep an eye out for anomalies and find a way out.

3547420.name: Ire: A Prologue
3547420.short_description: It’s 1986, and you’re stranded in the Bermuda Triangle -- but not alone. Trapped in a terrifying loop with a monster, you’ll have to stay one step ahead to survive and uncover the truth. Ready or not, here it comes.

2132890.name: Possessor(s)
2132890.short_description: Possessor(s) is a fast-paced action side scroller with combat inspired by platform fighters, a story told through dangerous characters, set in a deep interconnected world ready for exploration.

3419690.name: Chicken Run: Eggstraction
3419690.short_description: Stealth, silliness, and a whole lot of chaos! Scurry and scramble your way to freedom in this co-op adventure set in the Chicken Run universe.

3539440.name: Metal Garden
3539440.short_description: Travel through an overgrown megastructure, and discover what lies beyond it. Metal Garden is a short, atmospheric singleplayer FPS game.

3659280.name: Off The Grid
3659280.short_description: Welcome to Off The Grid, the next-gen free to play Battle Royale from visionary director Neill Blomkamp. Set in a near-future world where contestants are cybernetically augmented and dropped into televised bloodsport. Death is temporary, but fame is forever.

2426120.name: Concubine
2426120.short_description: A sensual, dark fantasy hack & slash ARPG. Fully customize an attractive concubine and up to three female companions with deep cosmetic details. Be the private assassin of the Sultan and earn sexy outfits, powerful weapons & mystic skills. Design & customize your Harem base at the Grand Palace.

3888420.name: Kumarn: The Wandering Spirit
3888420.short_description: Ripped from his shrine by a forbidden ritual, Kumarn - a young child spirit is cast into a world where haunting ancient folklore has become a terrifying reality. Relentlessly stalked by twisted creatures born from Thai tales, they must brave a land consumed by darkness to find their way home.

2705130.name: Exoborne
2705130.short_description: Exoborne is an open-world, tactical extraction shooter set in a world torn apart by extreme forces of nature. Customize powerful exo-rigs to gain strategic advantage in ever-changing weather conditions. Face hostile factions, enemy players, and Mother Nature herself in intense high-stakes sessions.

3050900.name: ROMEO IS A DEAD MAN
3050900.short_description: Paint the screen red and travel the cosmos in this bloodstained action adventure game! Witness the latest from Grasshopper Manufacture: the advent of ULTRA-VIOLENT SCIENCE FICTION!

2088020.name: UNDEFEATED: Genesis
2088020.short_description: Become the hero Voltissia needs. Fly freely across a vast alien planet, master extraordinary superpowers, and battle ferocious mutants in an expansive superhero action RPG.

2524850.name: Denshattack!
2524850.short_description: Flip, trick and grind your train in a fast-paced, off-the-rails ride through a colourful Japanese dystopia. Outmatch rival gangs, wreck a shady megacorp, and take back the tracks with nothing but skill, speed, and style.

4767480.name: Lords of the Fallen II
4767480.short_description: Lords of the Fallen II is a dark fantasy action-RPG where brutal, soulslike combat meets a world splitting at its core. Battle against the darkness in an epic adventure across a shattered kingdom. One world. Two realms. No mercy.

2215200.name: LEGO® Batman™: Legacy of the Dark Knight
2215200.short_description: Rise as the Dark Knight and experience the essential Batman story in a bold, action-packed adventure with hard-hitting combat, an open-world Gotham City, and the signature LEGO charm that fans know and love.

2141130.name: Road Kings
2141130.short_description: Drive a 40-ton semi hauling cargo across the coastal plains of the American South, managing multiple jobs, trailers, and routes. Grow reputation from rookie to veteran owner-operator, dodging disasters and rivals to become the hero of the open road.

2828710.name: Valor Mortis
2828710.short_description: Valor Mortis is a first-person action soulslike from the creators of Ghostrunner. Rise from death as a former soldier of Napoleon’s army. Wield supernatural powers, battle horrifying monsters, and unravel a conspiracy that threatens all of humanity.

2102450.name: Enotria: The Last Song
2102450.short_description: Enotria: The Last Song is a soulslike set in a beautiful sun-lit world inspired by Italian folklore where the brightest sun casts the darkest shadow. Wear unique role-altering masks, face formidable foes and alter reality with the power of Ardore to unravel the secrets of Enotria.

2353060.name: Invincible VS
2353060.short_description: Invincible VS is a brutal superhero 3v3 tag fighting game set in the Invincible universe, where you can battle to the death as a team of fan-favorite characters in iconic locations.

3219630.name: Halloween: The Game
3219630.short_description: On Halloween night, 1978, no one is safe from Michael Myers. Become the Boogeyman or fight back against the face of evil itself in Halloween.

1895900.name: 1348 Ex Voto
1895900.short_description: Journey through a tumultuous Medieval Italy as Aeta, a young knight errant who sets off on a brutal quest to find and save her closest one. 1348 Ex Voto is a cinematic action-adventure game inspired by chivalric tales.

1342490.name: Daemon X Machina: Titanic Scion
1342490.short_description: Feel the exhilaration of fast-paced combat in your fully customized armored suit as you freely explore a deadly and dangerous world on land or in the air. Take on titanic boss battles with alone or with up to two other friends in online co-op!

3744040.name: Kaidan
3744040.short_description: Brutal and unforgiving, Kaidan plunges you into a nightmarish vision of Japanese dark fantasy twisted by cosmic horror. Alone or with friends, strategise carefully as you endure a relentless descent into madness, where every moment is a vicious fight to survive.

2542020.name: Duskfade
2542020.short_description: Shatter the shackles of time as you jump, swing, and slash through a fantastic world in this love letter to classic 3D action platformers. Zirian, accompanied by his mechanical Cuckoo, must save his sister from a mysterious Clock Tower that has plunged the land into eternal night.

2362050.name: MY HERO ACADEMIA: All’s Justice
2362050.short_description: SMASH through your foes in MY HERO ACADEMIA: All's Justice and dive into variety of game modes where you can experience thrilling 3v3 battles, hero training, and the climactic Final War!

3086590.name: Gods, Death & Reapers
3086590.short_description: An innovative ExtrAction RPG set in an afterlife where mythology is real and the gods are dead. Fight through PvPvE, PvE, or as a party to claim valuable loot and bring balance to the shattered realms.

3073940.name: God Save Birmingham
3073940.short_description: Judgment Day has come to medieval Birmingham, and a plague of flesh-hungry ghouls has claimed every living soul… except one. Fight to survive in a highly tactile, physics-based survival sim where every object can be manipulated. Make ends meet, or meet your end.

2468730.name: Dungeon Stalkers
2468730.short_description: Dungeon Stalkers is a PvEvP dungeon crawler game where you can experience the joy of exploration and survival in a classic RPG. Join forces with your companions to defeat other adventurers and monsters, and acquire equipment and treasures. Then, escape safely from the witch's curse!

2343900.name: Project Werewulf
2343900.short_description: Project Werewulf is a 3D third person adult survival horror game with a female protagonist. Story driven linear gameplay with semi-open world elements.

2406180.name: Knights Within
2406180.short_description: Knights Within is a hack&slash horde shooter with roguelite elements. Design custom loadouts, navigate procedurally generated levels and utilize random power-ups. Either solo or with friends, can you survive endless waves of enemies to ensure humanity's survival?

3037180.name: 深空七号 Deep Space 7
3037180.short_description: This is an independent action shooting game with a third person horror atmosphere. Facing the terrifying monsters in the space station, you must overcome the shortage of supplies, solve numerous mysteries, and successfully escape danger

1622630.name: Otherskin
1622630.short_description: Embark on a deadly solo mission to uncover Vandermire’s secrets. Absorb alien morphs to evolve beyond human limits. Guided by your AI suit, explore alien biomes, master unique abilities, and fight to survive in a stunning action adventure. The universe is at stake.

2626910.name: Aviators
2626910.short_description: An educational adventure game about Polish air personnel during World War II. Meet the pilots of the 1586 Special Destiny Squadron and join them on incredible assignments. Explore and solve puzzles to learn more about the history of Polish aviation.

3094480.name: Bad Cheese
3094480.short_description: Bad Cheese is a psychological horror inspired by the eerie charm of 1920s animation. Step into the tiny paws of a mouse spending the weekend at home with a dysfunctional Dad while Mom's away. Be on your best behavior and KEEP DADDY HAPPY.

3612850.name: The Lightkeeper
3612850.short_description: Alone on a remote island, you're tasked with keeping a lighthouse. But the horrific events that claimed the lives of previous keepers still whisper through the air. Each day, the line between reality and delusion fades and something in the dark is waiting for the last keeper

2827820.name: The Relic: First Guardian
2827820.short_description: A dark action RPG rooted in Korean mythology, with brutal, fast combat.

2976250.name: Riven Crown
2976250.short_description: Riven Crown is an exhilarating Souls-like game that merges fighting game with traditional combat mechanics. Level up and gain abilities by mastering various armors and weapons. explore a detailed non-linear world, and uncover hidden secrets. Join the quest to free the world from monarchy.

3631230.name: CastleMiner Z : Resurrection
3631230.short_description: The cult survival shooter returns. Rebuilt in Unreal Engine 5, CastleMiner Z: Resurrection brings next-gen visuals, brutal combat, and infinite worlds to explore. Mine, craft, build, and survive against the undead, dragons, and the deadly unknown.

4115450.name: Phantom Blade Zero
4115450.short_description: S-GAME presents Phantom Blade Zero, a fusion of classic Wuxia storytelling and exhilarating action powered by Unreal Engine 5. You play as Soul, a warrior with only sixty-six days left to live. Fend off assassins, unravel world-ending conspiracies, and defend your values with your life.

3086580.name: LOST EMBER: Rekindled Edition
3086580.short_description: Explore the acclaimed animal adventure in never before seen beauty! Slip into the role of different animals to uncover the fate of an ancient world. Dive into deep waters, fly at lofty heights or even climb steep cliffs with a mountain goat, there are lots of ways of getting around.

2687400.name: GODBREAKERS
2687400.short_description: Fast, Fluid, Frenetic! Break gods, steal powers, and chain abilities in a hectic combat loop. This 1-4 player co-op action roguelite is built for fast pick-up sessions and endlessly replayable chaos. Experience tough battles and maximum expression where every run feels rewarding!

3014320.name: OCTOPATH TRAVELER 0
3014320.short_description: Start from zero and discover the newest entry in the OCTOPATH TRAVELER series. Experience a story of restoration and retribution over the divine rings—an epic saga that unfolds across the realm of Orsterra.

1872800.name: EVE Vanguard
1872800.short_description: EVE Vanguard is an extraction-adventure FPS set on the ruthless planets of New Eden. Raid crash sites, assault forward bases and seize exotic tech before colossal Nemesis Drones hunt you down. Every mission is a race against time. Every extraction shapes a larger war. This is only the beginning.

1714530.name: Blood of Mehran
1714530.short_description: In Blood of Mehran, explore sweeping sand dunes, bustling bazaars and sprawling palaces. Go blade to blade with enemies, pick them off from a distance with your arrows, or slip by them like a ghost. Level up and build your legend.

3404260.name: Dead as Disco
3404260.short_description: Martial arts meets music video in Dead as Disco, a neon-drenched Beat ‘Em Up where every punch, kick, and combo syncs to the music. Join Charlie Disco on a quest to confront the villainous Idols and reunite the band.

2927000.name: CyberTaxi: Lunatic Nights
2927000.short_description: CyberTaxi Lunatic Nights is a free roam taxi driving simulator set in a dark-noir Prison City. As a cab driver you have to find your wrongfully accused sister and rescue her from this dystopian city-facility. Complete unique missions, defeat lurking thugs and maintain your fuel level to succeed!

1330430.name: Celestial Empire
1330430.short_description: Forge an empire under the watchful eyes of the gods! Take care of your people, develop efficient production chains and trade with other landlords. Ensure their survival through harsh winters and disasters.

3841510.name: DYNASTY WARRIORS 3: Complete Edition Remastered
3841510.short_description: A warrior worth a thousand reforged. A remake of DYNASTY WARRIORS 3 and DYNASTY WARRIORS 3: Xtreme Legends with modern graphics and even more thrilling action.

3143710.name: PUBG: BLINDSPOT
3143710.short_description: PUBG: BLINDSPOT is a 5v5 top-down tactical shooter built on clever positioning, tight teamwork, and shared vision. Choose unique Agents, create squad synergies and execute smart strategies that turn the tide of every round.

3734010.name: Project Retrograde: The Becoming
3734010.short_description: Project Retrograde: The becoming is a narrative-driven action adventure set in an underground world devastated by the ancient parasite L.U.C.A. As a bounty hunter symbiotic with a mysterious parasite. Explore ruined civilizations and uncover the truth behind cataclysm.

1995520.name: Pax Dei
1995520.short_description: Welcome to a vast, social sandbox MMO inspired by the legends of the medieval era. Here, myths are real, ghosts exist, and magic is unquestioned. Join thousands of players as you explore the land, build your home, forge your reputation, and craft your own stories. What world will you make?

2487150.name: Deconstruction Simulator
2487150.short_description: Deconstruction Simulator is the ultimate demolition simulator, offering you complete freedom of action and a wide array of contracts to complete. Get ready for spectacular destruction.

3558720.name: Out of Sight VR
3558720.short_description: Out of Sight VR pulls you into a chilling nightmare where you see through the eyes of a child’s only comfort: her teddy bear. Guide Sophie through a sinister mansion and evade the lurking horrors that stalk her every move. The shadows are watching. And Sophie is counting on you.

1783560.name: The Last Caretaker
1783560.short_description: Explore a drowned Earth, restore lost systems, and raise the last human seeds in this first-person survival-crafting adventure. Build, scavenge, defend, and launch humanity back to the stars.

3781520.name: The Last Sip
3781520.short_description: The Last Sip is a short, atmospheric single-player experience focused on exploration and environmental storytelling. Uncover clues in a mysterious sci-fi facility and piece together the story behind your strange awakening.

2549130.name: ASURAJANG
2549130.short_description: ASURAJANG is an online action PVP game that anyone can enjoy. It features an easy-to-pick-up Battle Royale mode with trendy Anime-style characters and combat that packs a serious punch. Pick your favorite character and engage in strategic battle among 33 players to claim victory!

3025290.name: UNDERWARD
3025290.short_description: UNDERWARD is a 1-4 player co-op horror exploration game. Investigators must carry «TEST-SUBJECT» monsters from a deadly underground abandoned hospital ward.

2643390.name: Star Trek: Voyager - Across the Unknown
2643390.short_description: Star Trek: Voyager - Across the Unknown is a story-driven survival strategy game in which the fate of the iconic starship is in your hands. Take the helm, manage the ship and resources, and make difficult decisions. Will you be able to bring home the ship and its crew?

2815060.name: Eclipse Breaker
2815060.short_description: Eclipse Breaker is a strategic action roguelike: dodge, parry, and strike in real‑time combat where every second counts. Master fast-paced combat, inspired by classic JRPGs, collect divine powers, and fight through ever-changing dungeons in a relentless cycle of epic boss battles.

3230960.name: EXODUS
3230960.short_description: Step forward into EXODUS™ — a cinematic, single-player action RPG set in a new, far-future sci-fi universe. Rise from salvager to Traveler, discover new worlds ravaged by the effects of time, and search for the key to humanity’s survival across the most dangerous reaches of space.

3917090.name: Assetto Corsa Rally
3917090.short_description: Assetto Corsa Rally is a high-fidelity rally sim built for precision and challenge. With 3D laser-scanned stages and cars, professional co-driver support, and dynamic conditions, it delivers a demanding, immersive experience where every second behind the wheel counts.

3512950.name: Monterey Jack
3512950.short_description: Run, run, run as fast as you can, you can’t escape the Cheese Man!

4048740.name: Bip and Bop
4048740.short_description: Help, step on, or sabotage your friend! In this 2-player only puzzle platformer, perfect chemistry is the only way through. Think your friendship can handle it?

3150170.name: God of Yoga
3150170.short_description: In a world of sensuality and grace, guide your yoga students through the power of movement, breath... and intimate connection. Feel the divine energy of pleasure! Abhyasa and Vairagya!

3873970.name: NASCAR 25
3873970.short_description: iRacing is proud to present NASCAR 25, the official game of NASCAR featuring ALL FOUR National Series, the ARCA Menards Series, NASCAR Xfinity Series, NASCAR Craftsman Truck Series, and NASCAR Cup Series.

2352620.name: Fellowship
2352620.short_description: Choose your hero, form your group and battle through dungeons together in a Multiplayer Online Dungeon Adventure. Progress through Leagues, endlessly scaling Dungeons and chase new rewards with every fresh season. With a growing roster of Heroes and content there’s always something new in FELLOWSHIP

2806050.name: Halo: Campaign Evolved
2806050.short_description: Halo: Campaign Evolved is a faithful yet modernized remake of Halo: Combat Evolved’s campaign, rebuilt from the ground up.

2461440.name: Bylina
2461440.short_description: Enter a world of Slavic myth and medieval adventure. As a young bogatyr, journey to the Thrice-Nine Kingdom, challenge Koschei the Deathless, and save your immortal soul in Bylina – an epic action-adventure rooted in Slavic folklore, with a heavy focus on skill-based combat.

2406370.name: Darkblade Ascent
2406370.short_description: Fast paced First-Person Melee Roguelike RPG with randomly generated weapons and upgrades, unlockable new classes and persistent leveling. Hack and slash your way through atmospheric dark fantasy locations, unique monsters and bosses.

2686630.name: Voyagers of Nera
2686630.short_description: Voyagers of Nera is a cooperative survival-crafting game where you must survive a magical ocean world brimming with lost spirits and deadly monsters. Sail to distant islands, build beautiful villages and surf across the waves with up to 10 players.

3109270.name: Good Night Pan Pan
3109270.short_description: Explore and investigate the dimly lit halls of a nearly abandoned shopping mall in cyberpunk Hong Kong all while being stalked by a mysterious Yuan Gui, a malevolent spirit hell-bent on taking your soul. Good Night Pan Pan is a short 3rd person survival horror homage to Cantonese horror and culture!

2348120.name: Kagura Survivors: Endless Night
2348120.short_description: Something is wrong in the Kaguraverse. An anomaly is creating tears in space-time and causing parallel worlds to converge! It falls upon Kagura-chan, the vessel of the Goddess's will, to get to the bottom of this crisis and return order to the various universes.

3886200.name: BrokenLore: DON’T LIE
3886200.short_description: BrokenLore: DON'T LIE is a Japanese psychological horror game exploring trauma, isolation, and a fractured reality where perception becomes increasingly unreliable.

1442530.name: Outbreak Island
1442530.short_description: Survive on a remote Island, where a mysterious Outbreak awakens bloodthirsty monsters at night. Craft, build and defend your base in the brutal world of Outbreak Island, an open-world sandbox survival horror game.

1602000.name: Hotel Architect
1602000.short_description: Step into the shoes of a hotel owner as you design, build, and manage grand hotels around the world. Juggle demanding guests, frantic logistics, and plenty of unexpected surprises in Hotel Architect; the ultimate hotel construction and tycoon management game!

1645820.name: SurrounDead
1645820.short_description: SurrounDead is an open world survival game. Taking place in a world ravaged by an apocalyptic catastrophe. The dead reign free and will stop at nothing to kill you.

3228590.name: Deadzone: Rogue
3228590.short_description: Deadzone: Rogue is a roguelite FPS set in space. Blast through swarms of hostile machines, combine powerful augments and elements to forge your build, and grow stronger with each run — solo or in co-op.

2942700.name: Seed of Heroes
2942700.short_description: Journey through the realms with your heroes party. Defeat hordes of enemies in a bullet heaven and reach Valhalla where you belong.

3026450.name: Deadly Days: Roadtrip
3026450.short_description: Loot, shoot, and mow down zombie hordes in this bullet heaven fever dream. Embark on a deadly roadtrip, fuel your bus, decide when to extract – and get that sweet inventory management kick when that new slot in your backpack fits just right.

3114900.name: Dread Flats
3114900.short_description: This is a first-person Chinese horror game, players will go to a murder building, uncover the truth of the murder, find the missing people..

3254050.name: The Black Ice
3254050.short_description: A survival horror game where every breath could be your last. Explore a sinister Antarctic complex, unravel its mysteries, and try to survive before the darkness consumes you.

4153760.name: BOLD: Networked Newt Action
4153760.short_description: BOLD: Networked Newt Action redefines multiplayer stealth action for the modern day, with a return to classic Spies vs Mercs style 2v2 asymmetrical gameplay in a dark Sci-Fi world with anthropomorphic animals. 3rd person stealth is pitted against 1st person action in maps set across exotic locales!

3440070.name: Dinoblade
3440070.short_description: Dinoblade is an intense action RPG set in a prehistoric world forever changed by a cataclysmic event. Step into the role of a young Spinosaurus, wielding a colossal Great Sword. Confront rival dinosaurs, some armed with weapons of their own, all in a desperate fight to prevent a looming extinction.

1918830.name: The Time I Have Left
1918830.short_description: The Time I Have Left is a time-driven escape adventure with RPG elements set in a complex underground facility. A mysterious phenomenon known only as ‘The Miasma’ has marked Aline for certain death. Can you help her escape the desolate halls of Colony 7?

3690010.name: Who's at the door?
3690010.short_description: You are trapped in a small house, suffering from psychosis with no memory. Carefully observe your surroundings to distinguish reality from hallucinations, and overcome your illness by taking medication from visitors at the right time.

2489330.name: Whiskerwood
2489330.short_description: Establish a home for your industrious mice under the oppressive paw of your cat overlords in this city builder featuring complex simulations, intricate production chains, and the age-old rivalry between cat and mouse.

4016300.name: Beer Machine
4016300.short_description: Your father needs a beer, and it's your job to get it. He doesn't care what it takes, so do what you must. Be quick though - it's not so safe in the dark.

2527360.name: Mizeria
2527360.short_description: Nuoli finds herself trapped away in a mysterious castle. Use her bow along with a unique platforming system, and climb your way back to freedom in this old-school inspired 3D Platformer.

2880460.name: Terroro
2880460.short_description: In this psychological horror game about a famous TikToker, you take on the role of her boyfriend to discover that behind their perfect life, nothing is as it seems. Duration 30 minutes.

1379880.name: RED MACHINA
1379880.short_description: A narrative-driven atmospheric horror game. You are X and find yourself in the Red Machina system, a virtual paradise on the brink of collapse.

3896860.name: Conquer the Tower
3896860.short_description: 17s high schooler's game dream !See the world in my eye and the mechanism I've built!A tale of liberty and liberation,also a tale of oppression and enslavement..It is a platformer. Call on your friends! You are wield the power of electricity. then CONQUER the tower.

3417410.name: Storebound
3417410.short_description: A 1-3 player co-op puzzle horror game set in an accursed megastore. Work together to decode the store's twisted logic, and find a way out before the lurking horrors doom you to shop forever.

1920290.name: Barkour
1920290.short_description: BARKOUR is a fast-paced action platformer with a stealthy twist, starring Agent T.H.U.N.D.E.R. - a tail-wagging master of parkour, high-tech gadgets and getting into trouble. Jump, sneak and fight your way through a spy adventure packed with action, canine chaos and delightfully absurd surprises.

3802770.name: BLOODVILLE
3802770.short_description: BLOODVILLE is a short first-person shooter where you play as Cane, a retired hitman dragged back into killing - and slowly losing his mind.

3849030.name: Tired of Being the Hero
3849030.short_description: You saved the realm. Now you just want to chop wood, but monsters won't let you retire. Train your villagers, pull them out of harm's way, unlock new abilities to outlast the next assault, and try to remember why you became a Hero. Hold the line together in this short, story-rich, fantasy action RPG

3660710.name: Armatus
3660710.short_description: ARMATUS is a third-person roguelite shooter set in the demon-infested ruins of Paris. As the last supernatural warrior of an ancient order, armed with powerful firearms and incredible celestial powers, scour the city in search of a lost gateway to heaven - the Sunless Gate.

4096880.name: Raji: Kaliyuga
4096880.short_description: Six years after the great war, destiny bleeds into prophecy as gods and mortals blur. Raji, the warrior of faith, and Darsh, the dreamwalker, face Mahabalasura’s wrath as he tears open heaven’s gates, unleashing Kaliyuga-an age where every choice can unmake the universe.

2695430.name: A.I.L.A
2695430.short_description: A.I.L.A is a first-person horror game set in a near-future filled with immersive technology. Play as the sole game tester for a revolutionary new fictional AI. Survive intense horror experiences that prey on your deepest fears as the lines between virtual and reality begin to blur…

3636620.name: The Last Case of John Morley
3636620.short_description: Step into the mind of John Morley, a 1940s detective on his final case. Explore shadowed places long forgotten by time, and piece together crime scenes in a narrative adventure steeped in mystery, unexpected twists, and a truth buried for decades.

3194360.name: Formula Legends
3194360.short_description: From the golden age to the modern era, race through time in Formula Legends. Master reimagined circuits, command legendary cars, and compete online against players worldwide. A love letter to Formula racing where speed, skill, and strategy define champions.

2220660.name: Chiyo
2220660.short_description: [Chiyo] is a first-person hardcore escape room horror game set in Japan's Edo era. As Idate Chiyo, a paranormal investigator possessing supernatural abilities, you are tasked with investigating an abandoned mansion and unveiling a family's dark history and it's ultimate secret.

1925940.name: THE OFFICE ROOMS
1925940.short_description: A short exploration game blending liminal spaces and corporate dystopia. Explore an abandoned anomaly control facility and uncover its past and purpose!

2865670.name: JETRUNNER
2865670.short_description: JETRUNNER is a parkour FPS, with cel shaded, comic like visuals, and a gameplay loop that can be best described as Trackmania meets Titanfall. Rich, expressive movement, and tight gunplay is what JETRUNNER is all about.

3062610.name: She's Leaving
3062610.short_description: Put your forensic skills to the test in She’s Leaving, a first-person survival horror where players investigate brutal crime scenes, analyze blood-spatter evidence, and uncover the truth behind a series of disappearances.

3399290.name: Dead Format
3399290.short_description: Dead Format is a survival horror game set in iconic film eras. It's 1990s Scotland, and your brother has gone missing after becoming obsessed with a mysterious new VHS format. Follow his trail through the tapes and uncover why the government wants to ban "Video Ghastlies".

3583670.name: Where the forest ends
3583670.short_description: Shred zombies and bandits, collect and upgrade weapons, and explore the beauty hidden within industrial decay in a new story-driven, top-down horror shooter. Survive one more day in the post-apocalypse.

2536510.name: The God Slayer
2536510.short_description: Enter an Eastern-inspired steampunk metropolis where gods known as Celestials reign with a divine fist. In this open-world RPG, you are an Elemancer who refuses to bow. Infused with elemental powers and a heart of vengeance, you will dethrone them all. You will rise to be the God Slayer.

1712100.name: Carmageddon: Rogue Shift
1712100.short_description: Carmageddon smashes back with brutal roguelite vehicular‑combat mayhem. Adapt, upgrade, and unleash destruction on post‑apocalyptic zombie hordes. The legacy lives on, reinvented and unforgiving.

3634520.name: Samson
3634520.short_description: Samson returns to Tyndalston, a city that shaped him hard, where every fight is close and every escape is earned. He owes dangerous people more than he can pay, and they’re using his sister to force his hand. The clock is ticking. The only way out is through anyone who stands in his way.

2600920.name: When Sirens Fall Silent
2600920.short_description: When Sirens Fall Silent is a dark psychological thriller set in 1990s Italy. Play as Mila, a troubled policewoman drawn into a high-profile case of kidnappings and murders. As the case unravels you must not only save her from herself, but from being swallowed by a vortex of violence and confusion.

4061090.name: Rift Fishing
4061090.short_description: Rift Fishing is a multiplayer chatroom-focused fishing game. Fish through rifts into other worlds to catch mysterious creatures and artifacts. Make friends worldwide, paint together, and jam by the cozy campfire.

3170130.name: Red Recon: 1944
3170130.short_description: Red Recon is an isometric real-time tactics game with stealth elements, where you command a squad of Soviet scouts deployed into East Prussia in the autumn of 1944, on the eve of the Red Army’s strategic offensive. Be the first in the enemy’s lair!

2139020.name: What the Fog
2139020.short_description: What the Fog?! You’ve been sucked into a cursed boardgame! Now you and a friend will need to work together to survive. Run, jump, dash, and shoot to escape swarms of angry monsters in this chaotic co-op roguelite from the world of Dead by Daylight.

3597880.name: Cat Named Mojave
3597880.short_description: Stranded in the desert, your only hope of escaping rests in a strange Catman. His one request: hunt down surreal creatures, skin them, and chop them up so he can keep them as trophies.

2838460.name: ReThink 3.5
2838460.short_description: ReThink 3.5 is a previously unreleased Puzzle Game rebuilt in Unreal engine 5, in a peaceful futuristic setting, that features a variety of Puzzles that utilize Lasers and the behavior of light and it's colors to create challenging problems to solve.

2161710.name: NO LAW
2161710.short_description: Welcome to Port Desire, a city that doesn't belong to anyone, but where everyone wants a piece. You’re Grey Harker, an ex-military attempting to live a quiet life after near fatal injuries in the field. All you want now is peace - but in a city of no laws, what you want isn’t always what you get.

4078430.name: STAR WARS: Galactic Racer™
4078430.short_description: STAR WARS: Galactic Racer™ is a ​runs-based, ​high-stakes reinvention of racing born in the lawless Outer Rim. With the Empire gone and the galaxy rebuilding, The Galactic League is created: an underground, unsanctioned circuit where syndicates bankroll chaos and champions are forged.

3558670.name: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis
3558670.short_description: Experience a stunning reimagining of Lara Croft’s debut adventure to discover the lost secrets of Atlantis with jaw-dropping visuals, modern gameplay, and new surprises that honor the spirit of the original.

2288340.name: ACE COMBAT 8: WINGS OF THEVE
2288340.short_description: Soar through the skies and rise above every challenge to earn your place among the elite. Engage in intense aerial combat to dominate the battlefield with powerful weapons. Experience a breathtaking campaign filled with high-stakes missions, hard choices, and deep squad connections.

4128260.name: Highguard
4128260.short_description: Highguard is a PvP raid shooter where players will ride, fight, and raid as Wardens, arcane gunslingers sent to fight for control of a mythical continent.

3014520.name: BrokenLore: LOW
3014520.short_description: BrokenLore: LOW is a psychological horror game set in a mist-covered, beautiful Japanese village, blending hyper-realistic graphics with low-poly elements. The main enemy is the Gashadokuro, a yokai from Japanese folklore.

2351330.name: BrokenLore: DON'T WATCH
2351330.short_description: In BrokenLore: DON'T WATCH, immerse yourself in the haunting world of Shinji, a young hikikomori trapped in his Tokyo apartment. As his mind unravels, confront a malevolent entity lurking in the shadows. Will you uncover the truth before it's too late?

2133830.name: BrokenLore: UNFOLLOW
2133830.short_description: BrokenLore: UNFOLLOW is a first-person psychological horror game that explores the impact social media has on mental health through the story of Anne, a victim of bullying trapped in a surreal nightmare where she must solve a dark mystery and confront sinister creatures.

2846530.name: BrokenLore: FOLLOW
2846530.short_description: BrokenLore: FOLLOW is a psychological first-person horror game that immerses players in the haunting narrative of Anne, as she grapples with issues of self-acceptance, bullying, and worthlessness while encountering metaphorical surreal creatures that heighten the terror of her journey.

4051470.name: BrokenLore: ASCEND
4051470.short_description: BrokenLore: ASCEND is a first-person psychological horror with climbing and stealth mechanics. Follow Ren and Yui, two rooftop climbers facing a cursed tower and the terrifying Rokurokubi. The higher they climb, the closer they get to madness and to the truth about themselves.

2441310.name: Haunted Memories: The Return
2441310.short_description: Haunted Memories: The Return is a psychological horror in which you assume the role of yourself. You decide which path you will take and what will happen in Green Park this time. But the question remains - will you ever be able to leave?

2599690.name: Better Than Dead
2599690.short_description: A brutal bodycam revenge FPS set in Hong Kong. Slide into bullet time, fight up close, learn each environment's rhythm, and turn every run into a faster, bloodier revenge scene.

1721110.name: Abyssus
1721110.short_description: Choose your loadout, blast through the corrupted denizens of a sunken civilization, and wield godly powers in Abyssus – a fast-paced 1-to-4 players FPS and roguelite brinepunk adventure.

3571710.name: Leaf Blower Co.
3571710.short_description: Blow your leaves and your cares away in this chilled out work sim. Build up your business, buy new tools, and unlock upgrades - all while watching the leaves fly. After all, one man’s trash is another man’s cash.

1632490.name: Shashingo: Learn Japanese with Photography
1632490.short_description: Shashingo is an edutainment game that teaches you Japanese through virtual photography. With your trusty camera, take photographs of the fictional streets of Japan to capture new words and images as fully translated flash cards!

2081580.name: Belonging
2081580.short_description: Belonging is a game about a cult and its victims. As a hacktivist breaking into a target location, the player searches an abandoned estate of a cult to find data to leak to the public and uncover uncomfortable truths about what happened to the people that lived there.

4181410.name: The Alley
4181410.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game. Explore a maze-like alleyway, using your camera to distinguish between supernatural "Aberrations" and deceptive "Deceptions" while escaping the relentless pursuit of a vengeful ghost.

3255890.name: Relooted
3255890.short_description: Reclaim real African artifacts from Western museums in this Africanfuturist heist game. Recruit crew members, plan escape routes, acquire the precious cargo, and bounce out of the joint as fast as you can.

2624870.name: Life is Strange: Reunion
2624870.short_description: The saga of Max and Chloe, and the fate of Caledon, is yours to decide! Play as both Max and Chloe as an all-new story builds towards an epic climax. The fire will force Max and Chloe to make devastating decisions. Can they find a future together… Before everything burns?

3296990.name: Fearwoods
3296990.short_description: Fearwoods is a 4 co-op survival horror where light and silence are your only weapons. Explore the cursed forest, uncover Aveline’s story, evade a relentless demon, and fight for escape before the darkness consumes you.
