3103420.name: Attrax
3103420.short_description: Opposites attract and likes repel. Enter the mysterious world of Attrax in this captivating single-player experience. Solve logic puzzles based on attraction and repulsion, and uncover the origins of the institute. Enjoy hours of gameplay that will redefine your understanding of physics and logic.

2653240.name: Knight's Path: The Tournament
2653240.short_description: This game is a free CONCEPT demo created to showcase early ideas for Knight’s Path and does NOT represent the final game!!! The Tournament is a short medieval action RPG featuring challenging combat, an immersive progression system, and a nice little story.

3426150.name: I Have No Change
3426150.short_description: “I Have No Change” is a first-person narrative game that immerses players in the atmosphere of a night kiosk filled with stories, melancholia, and the reflections of residents from Russia’s regions.

1914980.name: Golfing in Aether
1914980.short_description: Minigolf for up to 16 players online, or 4 players via split screen. Features randomized course layout allowing you to experience something different every time you play.

3449370.name: VANRAN
3449370.short_description: VANRAN is a dark fantasy action RPG where a human slave in the Demon Realm wields a sealed blade and rises in rebellion. Defeat your enemies, claim their powers, grow stronger, and escape. Seek salvation—or choose vengeance.

4295810.name: A Whisper of Fall: Jinyiwei
4295810.short_description: "A Whisper of Fall: Jinyiwei" is an ARPG set in the Ming Dynasty. Play as a Jinyiwei (Imperial Guard) with martial art, lightness skill and the unique deduction ability, across shifting timelines and sandbox levels to weave the destiny of yourself and the dynasty.

4346690.name: Genigods: Nezha
4346690.short_description: Genigods: Nezha is an ARPG rooted in the chaos of ancient Chinese creation mythology. Play as Spirit Pearl, the first being forged by the Goddess of Creation Nüwa. Dive into iconic Chinese genesis tales, battle Colossal Gods, and experience the unique combat of Chinese-style celestial showdowns.

2918090.name: Fear The Timeloop
2918090.short_description: Sheriff James Cooper is slowly bleeding to death in an unfamiliar hospital. But the moment his life ends, everything starts over. He has fifteen minutes to break this endless cycle, uncover the truth, and find a way out before it's too late.

2610650.name: Don't Stop, Girlypop!
2610650.short_description: Spread the love! Don’t Stop, Girlypop! is a Y2K arena movement shooter where standing still is not an option. ❤ Just ❤ Don’t ❤ Stop ❤ Moving! ❤

3483510.name: The Adventures of Elliot: The Millennium Tales
3483510.short_description: A brand-new action RPG from the creators of OCTOPATH TRAVELER and BRAVELY DEFAULT – The Adventures of Elliot: The Millennium Tales combines stunning HD-2D visuals and exciting action-adventure gameplay for the first time!

2191500.name: Vampires: Bloodlord Rising
2191500.short_description: In this dark, open-world adventure, you awaken as a Vampire Lord. Build and customize your castle. Hunt for blood, fight, craft, and gather. Command your loyal servants. Shapeshift into a bat to explore the night and survive the relentless Inquisition, solo or in 4-player co-op.

1636440.name: SILENT HILL: Townfall
1636440.short_description: Returning to an island town to ‘put things right’, Simon Ordell descends into a world of tense evasion, explosive confrontations, and mind-bending puzzles that slowly surface the truth of St. Amelia.

2492670.name: METAL GEAR SOLID 4: Guns of the Patriots - Master Collection Version
2492670.short_description: Solid Snake's final mission. Five years after the Big Shell incident, in an era where war has become a business due to the rise of PMCs (Private Military Contractors). To stop Liquid Ocelot's uprising, the legendary hero Solid Snake faces his final battle.

1795190.name: Speedball
1795190.short_description: A brand new entry into the legendary Bitmap Brothers series! Venture into the grim future of 2138 where mega-corporations use Speedball to distract the downtrodden masses from their miserable lives.

2582140.name: Seafarer: The Ship Sim
2582140.short_description: Build your maritime career solo or with up to 4 players. Take on contracts across diverse harbors, command different ships, and tackle cargo runs, patrols, rescues, firefighting, and unexpected events in a vast Northern European open world.

1749860.name: Lushfoil Photography Sim
1749860.short_description: A tranquil exploration and photography experience set across a vast selection of faithfully detailed landscapes.

2738170.name: Edge of Memories
2738170.short_description: The population of Avaris is ravaged by the Corrosion, a terrible affliction that mutates all it infects into grotesque abominations. Play as Eline, a young nomad, and lead fierce battles alongside your allies to save the world from extinction.

3326230.name: Hozy
3326230.short_description: Restore a forgotten neighbourhood through your favourite hobby, one cozy room at a time. In Hozy, clean, paint, and decorate abandoned homes with satisfying mechanics and intuitive controls. Enjoy the little details as you interact with tools, items and furniture to bring each space back to life.

3041230.name: Windrose
3041230.short_description: Embark on a PvE survival adventure in the Age of Piracy. Fight on land and sea, solo or with friends. Build, craft and explore vast open world filled with dark secrets. Master soulslite combat and take on challenging bosses, command your ship and plunder unspoken treasures!

3592940.name: Flesh & Wire
3592940.short_description: Delve into the psychological roots of the POSTAL series in Flesh & Wire, a horror first person shooter that ventures into the twisted reality of a hapless victim seeking enshrouded answers and grisly vengeance against the crazed gunman who changed her life forever.

4157130.name: Dark Pals: The 1st Floor
4157130.short_description: In this mascot horror game, you explore an abandoned children’s asylum and solve deceptive puzzles with your plush squid gun. Escape Chompy Chasey, befriend (or avoid) Binky Drinky, and uncover secrets you had long forgotten about. Do you remember?

2849490.name: Outward 2
2849490.short_description: Outward 2 is a challenging action RPG with survival elements, focusing around a grounded experience. There’s no hand-holding, no scaled encounters, no divine blessings to make you tower over your enemies. Eat your meal, check your map, grab your backpack: an unforgiving, rewarding adventure awaits.

3161310.name: Hela: of Mice & Magic
3161310.short_description: See the world through the eyes of a brave little mouse in this enchanting 3D co-op adventure. Explore breathtaking landscapes inspired by Northern Sweden, solve puzzles, and be a force for good in a land where heartwarming storytelling and the beauty of nature intertwine.

2636420.name: Graveyard Shift
2636420.short_description: Guarding the graveyard shift is often considered one of the most terrifying jobs globally, but night guarding at Whispering Winds Cemetery surpasses any other cemetery in horror! Being Night Security in this place will turn into a nightmare for you that you may never forget.

2936810.name: RUINER 2
2936810.short_description: RUINER 2 is a Cyberpunk Action RPG set in the cult-classic world of RUINER, where death must be earned. Experience brutal, lightning-fast combat with deep systems. Use the new ‘Shell System’ to switch characters mid-combat and exploit lethal combos in single player or up to 3P co-op.

2244210.name: Echoes of Aincrad
2244210.short_description: Step into Aincrad, a world of beauty and danger where every battle could be your last. Create your hero, choose your gear, and master combat by building synergy with your partner, leveling up, and unlocking special abilities to expand your horizons.

3268150.name: Peregrino
3268150.short_description: Peregrino is a dark isometric survival adventure where you explore a cursed forest by day and manage your caravan by night. Gather resources, hunt deadly creatures, upgrade your caravan, care for your companions, and lead them through the vast wilderness in search of New Eden.

4128400.name: eBaseball™: PRO SPIRIT
4128400.short_description: Experience authentic baseball with players from around the world. Feel the arc of every hit, the intensity behind each play, and the roar of the crowd surrounding the stadium. With stunning presentation, the game captures the true intensity of real baseball.

3018390.name: PSYCHO DEAD
3018390.short_description: A third-person survival horror game that you play as a girl with psychic power who tries to escape from a secret lab and is pursued by deadly stalkers.

1867240.name: WARDOGS
1867240.short_description: WARDOGS is a TACTICAL ALL OUT WARFARE FPS where one hundred players split across three teams fight over the control zone. Set in the derelict industrial mountains of Eastern Europe on a destructible battlefield where teamwork pays and cash is king.

3707530.name: The Vernyhorn
3707530.short_description: A third-person open-world RPG inspired by classic role-playing roots. Follow a man haunted by his past as he faces his inner demons in a world shaped by faith, fear, and survival — where every choice leaves a mark that time cannot erase.

2753000.name: GOALS
2753000.short_description: GOALS is a fast, responsive football game built for pure skill, real competition, and a global community. Gameplay first, free to play, crossplay and unique players. No excuses - just football.

3335310.name: Remothered: Red Nun's Legacy
3335310.short_description: Your daughter has been kidnapped. In the trilogy’s final chapter, enter a nightmare to save her, survive what hunts you, and uncover the Red Nun’s truth through retrocognition, mirror abilities and moth manipulation. A modern return to classic survival horror with an Italian neo-giallo twist.

4491360.name: The 7th Guest Remake
4491360.short_description: The iconic game The 7th Guest has been brought back to life with modern technology, delivering an atmospheric story like no other. Explore a foreboding mansion, solve mind-bending puzzles, and uncover its dark secrets. The 7th Guest is the ultimate mystery adventure, reimagined for modern platforms.

3878740.name: Tiny Chills - Not From Ear
3878740.short_description: Uncover the mystery haunting Velviano. Clean people’s ears in a quiet town plagued by disappearances, grotesque anomalies, and things that should never be found beneath human skin.

3798840.name: Reytrieve Odyssey
3798840.short_description: Reytrieve Odyssey is a vibrant 3D platformer starring a feisty android girl on a quest to retrieve mysterious data disks! Switch between powerful cartridges, explore giant colorful islands, and uncover the secrets of a broken world!

3432750.name: Laundering Simulator - Clean Cash and Laundry
3432750.short_description: Laundering Simulator puts you in charge of a two-faced enterprise – a hidden counterfeiting workshop with a laundromat as its front! Help Eddie Wiser run this crazy show and deal with small-business management, a criminal underground, nosy authorities, and a rage-inducing grandmother!

3552140.name: Retro Rewind - Video Store Simulator
3552140.short_description: Manage your very own video store in the early 90s! Rent, sell, decorate and expand your business from the ground up and relive the golden ages of video rentals!

2963800.name: DrainSim
2963800.short_description: Dive into DrainSim and seize control of the floods! Clear the city's submerged streets, with a huge range of different tools from rakes to submersible pumps. Embrace the satisfaction of restoring the water flow. Become the city's hero, one drain at a time.

2253100.name: Everwind
2253100.short_description: Everwind is a novel take on RPG and Sandbox Survival genre in First-Person-Perspective. Embark on the adventure with your friends - Build a base on a flying island-ship, gather resources, craft, loot, and fight while you rise above the clouds to uncover the mysteries of this world!

4212050.name: Supreme Experiment
4212050.short_description: In a world abandoned by humans, machines have evolved into a new species—and found their own gods. Survive, explore, and fight to uncover the truth and realize that... nothing is what it seems. Perhaps, you can still save what remains of humanity.

3456660.name: PAYDAY: Aces High
3456660.short_description: Nothing hits like the moment the mask comes on. Plan bold jobs, pull off stylish chaos, and take down a business titan - one explosive score at a time. High stakes, big money, no mercy: PAYDAY: Aces High is the definitive VR co-op heist game for up to 4 players. Revenge has never felt so good.

4434610.name: Hunter: The Reckoning – Deathwish
4434610.short_description: In the bustling streets of New York, passersby are unaware of the evil lurking in the shadows. You, however, know. Hunt the creatures of the World of Darkness in this action RPG, where your choices determine whether you live another day.

2067210.name: Serious Sam: Shatterverse
2067210.short_description: Serious Sam: Shatterverse is a co-op roguelite FPS for 1 - 5 players. Blast through shifting universes, stack wild boons, bend the rules with run modifiers, and hunt Mental's deadliest forces. Fall fast. Come back louder.

2962320.name: Artificial Detective
2962320.short_description: Artificial Detective is an action-adventure where you step into the shoes of a robodetective in a dystopian city overrun by rogue robots. Lead your underdog team of a military robodog and a human girl as you fight, hack, and outsmart your enemies to uncover why humans are gone.

1327040.name: Truck World: Australia
1327040.short_description: A trucking simulator set in Australia. Haul cargo on highways and off-road, step out of the cab, hitch trailers, connect hoses, refuel, and service your truck by hand. You don't just drive a truck - you work as a trucker.

2172910.name: CAPTAIN TSUBASA 2: WORLD FIGHTERS
2172910.short_description: The next episode of Tsubasa’s riveting adventure is here! Enjoy the thrill of spectacular soccer actions with 110 playable characters and new sensational super moves. Challenge a friend in the field or support Tsubasa on his Journey, the ball is yours.

2139090.name: Project ETHOS
2139090.short_description: Project ETHOS is a free-to-play, 3rd-person roguelike hero shooter in development.

3301370.name: Comatose
3301370.short_description: Explore your decaying mind in this story driven retro survival horror FPS. Manage scarce resources, solve puzzles, and fight your way back to the living.

2776090.name: Lay of the Land
2776090.short_description: Lay of the Land is a sandbox adventure game set in a fantasy world where everything is physically simulated. Use the environment to your advantage and Explore, Fight, Loot and Build your way through mysterious lands.

3558400.name: Backseat Drivers
3558400.short_description: A punishing 2-4 player driving test of your relationships. Gramma can't see and you can't drive. Together, you'll navigate the world's worst detour in an ancient car that handles even worse than it looks.

3273480.name: Reach
3273480.short_description: The ground-breaking new title from nDreams Elevation – the VR-immersion expert’s pioneering new studio. Embody a reluctant hero, wield extraordinary abilities, and journey into a perilous world of crossed realities. Are you ready to make the leap?

4536610.name: City Masterplan
4536610.short_description: Break the grid and build a true 1:1 scale metropolis. City Masterplan is a realistic city builder where traffic, citizens, and economy form a fully simulated system. Design complex road networks freely, manage real congestion, and shape a city through the decisions you make.

4271520.name: The Pines
4271520.short_description: A psychological horror RPG where every choice has consequences. After a failed case, former detective Edward Walker arrives at The Pines, a secluded retreat with therapists on site and the promise of peace. But beneath its carefully constructed calm, something is deeply wrong.

3079170.name: ASKET
3079170.short_description: Go to the vicinity of the “dead city”. A mystical place, full of strange anomalies, wild creatures, rare artifacts and ascetics!

3892510.name: Asterfel
3892510.short_description: Welcome to Asterfel, an island shaped by ambition, conflict, and something far older stirring beneath the surface. Encounter three factions, discover forgotten history, and shape the island’s future. Will you thrive, survive, or witness the end of an era?

4094660.name: Rivage
4094660.short_description: Rivage is a first person escape room-style puzzle game. Trapped in a cosmic anomaly aboard the A.R.E.S. space station, wake up as Miranda, a brilliant scientist and solve intricate puzzles to unravel the fate of your missing crew.

3516780.name: 2nd EVE
3516780.short_description: Reality broke when the ARGOS jumped into hyperspace. Sister Superior Zola must navigate corridors where her own crew has twisted into monsters, rogue machines hunt the living, and deadly anomalies tear through the ship. Humanity's last survivors lie frozen in cryosleep, depending on you.

3193770.name: The Exit 8 VR
3193770.short_description: The popular indie game “The Exit 8” is reborn and brought to virtual life as “The Exit 8 VR”! Experience the eerie and thrilling atmosphere of Japan's underground passageways, now with new anomalies!

1368140.name: Corsair Cove
1368140.short_description: Build a sprawling pirate haven, raise a fleet to explore the high seas, and take on the Crown to keep the Age of Piracy alive! From ale to flintlock pistols, and from scallywags to swashbucklers, you’ll need to manage complex production chains and govern a rowdy crew to reign supreme over the seas!

3849000.name: The Lantern of the Laughless Saint
3849000.short_description: A solo or co-op RPG inspired by Morrowind. Drawn by a shared dream, you awaken on an isolated island crowned by a silent Tower. Unravel the mystery of the Laughless Saint, confront the weight of human desire, and decide what deserves to be saved when the light beneath the world finally stirs.

2605790.name: Deep Rock Galactic: Rogue Core
2605790.short_description: DEEP ROCK GALACTIC: ROGUE CORE is a 1-4 player co-op shooter with sci-fi dwarves, procedurally-generated caves and random roguelike upgrades. Explore maze-like mines and blast through hordes of alien abominations — no two runs are the same. Move quickly, work together and shoot first to survive.

2835590.name: 8AM
2835590.short_description: "8AM" is a suspense game where you find yourself trapped in a room, watching a family through cameras. Without explanations, you must decide if strange events occur night after night. Being correct extends the time, seeking your release by 8:00 a.m.

4549480.name: BrokenLore: DON'T PLAY
4549480.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game where a mysterious experimental video game invades reality. Face five increasingly disturbing levels and survive their consequences as Hideo slips toward identity loss.

3748520.name: SPRAWL zero
3748520.short_description: SPRAWL zero is a fast-paced shooter inspired by the Golden Age of 2000s FPS. Survive a brutal cyberpunk city collapsing under military rule and cult fanaticism. Use your Gravity-Gloves, augments, and an arsenal of over 40 weapons to crush those who stand in your way.

2595940.name: Magical Bakery
2595940.short_description: Experience a life full of magic, challenges, and the joy of creating sweets that will leave a spellbinding impression on your customers. Become the ultimate magical baker and prove yourself worthy to inherit the Magical Bakery!

3565040.name: Rumbral
3565040.short_description: Rumbral is a dark, puzzle platformer set in a seemingly forgotten world. Find your way in this desolated place while trying to recover your memories and find out who you really are.

4508340.name: NTE: Neverness to Everness
4508340.short_description: NTE is a supernatural urban open-world RPG developed by Hotta Studio. Your story begins in Hethereau as an unlicensed anomaly hunter. Team up with a diverse cast of companions, each with unique abilities, to unravel the city's mysteries.

4064510.name: MOLE
4064510.short_description: Pilot the MOLE, a monstrous post-war drilling machine built to descend deep below the Slavic soil. Fix failing systems, follow voices of the dead, and pray you can survive whatever is sharing your coffin. Will the vessel or your mind break first?

3636440.name: Click To Continue
3636440.short_description: A strange white room. One button. Endless clicking. Unlock bizarre upgrades, face unexpected challenges, and uncover a hidden truth in this surreal, humorous, short clicker game.

2446760.name: YASUKE: A Lost Descendant
2446760.short_description: Dash. Slash. Glide. Discover your legacy as the heir to a legendary African samurai in this high-velocity 3D action game, featuring futuristic swordplay, kinetic parkour, and anime-inspired action.

4139880.name: Inner Voice
4139880.short_description: A slow-burning first-person adventure where a mysterious narrator guides your choices through a dreamlike world of grief, symbols and secrets.

3124540.name: Far Far West
3124540.short_description: Yee-haw, Cowboys! Team up in this chaotic 1-4 player co-op shooter. Journey to the Far Far West to blast monsters, sling spells, complete missions, and collect bounties. Work as a team to get in, get paid and get out (mostly) alive.

2119740.name: United heist
2119740.short_description: Your crew consists of two elite thieves. A client hires you to steal a mysterious item. One handles intel; the other infiltrates. Choose your roles and master the heist in this asymmetric co-op puzzle game.

2854480.name: Blindfire
2854480.short_description: Blindfire delivers unique FPS action in pitch-black arenas. Rely on sound and high-tech gadgets to develop your skills in new ways. Ideal for quick, high-tension matches with friends.

3871570.name: Eilean Mor: The Lost Keepers
3871570.short_description: At the beginning of the 20th century, the Eilean Mor lighthouse fell silent. The light is out, and its three keepers are missing. No one is answering the radio. As a reserve keeper, you’re sent to investigate this horror mystery. But beware you may become the fourth to vanish.

1648360.name: Luminary
1648360.short_description: Luminary is a solo or co-op OpenZone Action RPG that creates a balanced experience for everyone. Using a unique world and character progression system, explore vast hand-crafted lands together, uncover hidden treasures, level up your town, and push back the darkness with light.

2861210.name: HYPNOS
2861210.short_description: HYPNOS is a first-person adventure and exploration game, set in a lovecraftian megastructure fever dream. Enter the Nameless City at the edge of Dreams. Follow the trail into the shadow of the Holy Mountain. Embrace your destiny.

2948560.name: Instants
2948560.short_description: Assemble a chronological puzzle of family photos to piece together their most cherished memories. Uncover the family's life story as you arrange the pictures in the correct order within carefully crafted albums. Unleash your creativity and decorate them with multiple scrapbooking tools!

3223390.name: BLACKSHARD
3223390.short_description: BLACKSHARD is a first-person exploration game. Wander through a strange megastructure, the Labyrinth, to unravel its mysteries... Your behavior within the Labyrinth will define the outcome of your journey. What path will you choose to take?

2727660.name: GlitchSPANKR
2727660.short_description: GlitchSPANKR is a comedy-driven narrative adventure full of secrets, chaos, minigames, and unexpected choices. Spank, spare, or smooch your way through a corrupted 90s game haunted by a lonely, unstable virus. Every level is different. Every choice matters. Your future is in your wiggly hand.

4465790.name: Deadzone Rogue 2
4465790.short_description: Fight as Talon 13-10 in this FPS roguelite adventure set on a fallen Earth. Combine weapons, augments, and elements to forge devastating builds, and blast through Monarch’s endless machines. Grow stronger each run, solo or with friends.

3079210.name: Hell Let Loose: Vietnam
3079210.short_description: Step into the explosive fury of war with Hell Let Loose: Vietnam. Play a decisive role in one of the most iconic conflicts in history with expansive 50v50 player battles, where teamwork, tactics and an arsenal of destructive weapons combine to shape the battlefield in your favour.

2525510.name: NITRO GEN OMEGA
2525510.short_description: A sandbox tactical RPG of steel, fire, friendship, and shonen anime. Assemble your crew, customize your Mech, and lead them in cinematic turn-based battles through a world ruled by rogue AI. The bonds you forge will decide who survives!

4119360.name: It Reaches
4119360.short_description: It Reaches is a first person horror game, captured through the lens of a police officer’s body cam. Trapped inside the facilities of an abandoned hospital, find a way to escape the horrors lurking underground. Uncover a dark mystery left behind and don't get caught! They will reach for you…

3056840.name: A Bumpy Ride
3056840.short_description: Take a jaunt into the world of A Bumpy Ride, a cozy train-driving and exploration game! Inspired by railroading of the 19th century with a whimsical spin, you'll adventure around the open frontier in your trusty little train, picking up passengers and freight.

3968040.name: Hollow Stories: Lockdown
3968040.short_description: A neo-retro survival horror noir game where you explore, solve puzzles, and fight to survive in a city ruled by corruption and cults.

3838790.name: The Twilight Project
3838790.short_description: A tourist who gets lost in a forgotten village. As night falls, strange and terrifying creatures begin to appear, and reality starts to shift into something far darker. A third person survival horror game where you can experience the intense story with unique theme of horror.

3548810.name: Ritual Tides
3548810.short_description: Ritual Tides is a story rich, psychological horror game set on the dark, atmospheric, isolated British island of Hortus. Explore the island, uncover its dark past, loot food, ammunition and supplies, evade the cult of the Fallow Parish, as you fight for survival against Lovecraftian horrors.

2747330.name: Species: Unknown
2747330.short_description: Species: Unknown is a 1 to 4 players co-op survival horror. Complete high-risk missions aboard an abandoned ship while being hunted by an unknown creature. Survive and upgrade your gear to face each new threat that lurks in the dark.

3979350.name: Butcherman
3979350.short_description: Experience the psychological horror of being kidnapped by a serial killer. Driven to escape, explore everything around you, use your wits, uncover secrets, and face the unimaginable dread of being in the victim’s place. Inspired by a true story.

4317690.name: Crimson Moon
4317690.short_description: You are Nephilim: a human-angel hybrid forged to defend humanity with supernatural powers. Fight solo or with a friend to annihilate demons and challenge brutal bosses in relentless melée combat. Rise, violent one. The prophecy is yours to fulfill.

4310610.name: The Skin Stapler
4310610.short_description: The Skin Stapler is a retro-styled PSX grindhouse horror adventure set in the rotting, crime-soaked sprawl of Carrion City. Players follow jaded detective Dick Slater and his eager rookie partner Robbie Knox as they hunt a mysterious serial killer known only as The Skin Stapler.

4131730.name: VHOLUME
4131730.short_description: VHOLUME is a melancholic first-person parkour adventure set in a dystopian brutalist city where bureaucracy turns a simple task into an odyssey.

3918930.name: Foreverthorn
3918930.short_description: Foreverthorn is a shooter game where you blast, kick and EXPLODE grim, thorny monsters. Explore the dungeons of Rose Chapel, find useful items and collect roses for your wife's grave.

4132890.name: Fright Train
4132890.short_description: Fight through a train overtaken by monsters and survive Antarctica’s cold as paranormal special agent Doug Barker in this chilling single-player third-person survival horror roguelike.

4125810.name: NZ78
4125810.short_description: A short atmospheric sci-fi story told through text and ink-wash images, as New Zealand faces strange events beyond explanation.

4431400.name: Smersh: Wolfhound
4431400.short_description: A stealth action game set during World War II. You play as a SMERSH operative. Use disguises to get close to your target. Take out your foes with weapons or plan “unfortunate accidents.” No two playthroughs are alike.

1373530.name: Militsioner
1373530.short_description: Every move you make is being followed by a Colossal Policeman. Anger, flatter, disappoint, deceive or even romance him to escape in this kafkaesque immersive sim.

1952620.name: The Lost Wild
1952620.short_description: True fear is primal. Embark on an evasion-based survival horror experience against nature’s ultimate hunters — dinosaurs. Explore overgrown research facilities nestled in a lush wilderness. Be resourceful as you evade, distract, survive, and unravel the mystery at the heart of the island.

3149370.name: ROGUE LIGHT DECK BUILDER
3149370.short_description: Your house needs a deck. You have a hammer. Freedom is $1,000,000.

2487330.name: Stuntman: Hollywood
2487330.short_description: Become Hollywood's most sought-after stuntman. Perform explosive scenes inspired by blockbuster movies, defy danger, and drift your way to stardom.

2336440.name: Once Alive
2336440.short_description: A story-driven, first-person adventure game offering a cinematic experience. Embark on a journey to HaustVille, an abandoned settlement in a post-apocalyptic world. Explore your surroundings and uncover the mystery behind the disappearance of the last survivors.

3574750.name: The Dark West
3574750.short_description: The Dark West is a western occult ARPG set across a dying frontier that is consumed by corruption. Fight to survive with era-specific weapons and dark magic as you face deadly encounters and uncover tools of destruction.

2865960.name: SAW: Genesis
2865960.short_description: A century before Jigsaw, survival demanded sacrifice. Experience the thrilling world of SAW first-hand in a new 3v1 multi-player horror game where three Accused must work together to escape a maze of traps, while one Judge orchestrates their rehabilitation.

4687500.name: Crossfire
4687500.short_description: Layla and Cross are two opposing operators, divided by ideology but united in a fragile alliance against a threat neither can survive alone. Tactical freedom meets grounded combat in a narrative-driven cinematic action-adventure.

3949550.name: 1666: Amsterdam
3949550.short_description: Every 333 years, something stirs. 1666: Amsterdam is a 3rd person Dark, Story-Led, Action-Adventure where Noa, the Collector, wields witchcraft to uncover demonic entities hiding behind human faces. Investigate by day. Face your demons at night.

4665290.name: Alien: Isolation 2
4665290.short_description: Face your ultimate fears in the long-awaited sequel to the award-winning survival horror game, Alien: Isolation.

4729320.name: Swords of Legends
4729320.short_description: Swords of Legends is a single-player action-adventure RPG set in the primordial age, a world drawn from the strange tales of classical Chinese literature, where mortals, gods, and wandering souls walk the same earth.

4251460.name: Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered
4251460.short_description: The ultimate Godzilla arena brawler is back, completely remastered. Choose your monster and battle it out with a range of brutal attacks through recreated cities and other locations. Face off against your friends and foes in local co-op or new online multiplayer.

3141390.name: GRAFT
3141390.short_description: YOU ARE THE SHIP OF THESEUS. Who, or what, will you be when you escape the Arc? A story-driven survival horror RPG from the makers of the Shadowrun Trilogy.

3676410.name: Senua
3676410.short_description: A Celtic warrior is trapped between life and death in a fractured vision of purgatory. In an action‑adventure set in the Hellblade universe, Senua fights to reach the afterlife and reunite with those she loved and lost, battling forces that threaten all she believes in.

2153760.name: Stronghold 4
2153760.short_description: Wood needed! Return to the green roots of Stronghold in this narrative prequel to the original 'castle sim'. Immerse yourself in a cinematic campaign, hone your siegecraft with new mechanics in skirmish mode and customise your castles with a wide selection of castle pieces and cosmetics.

4570720.name: DragonSword : Awakening
4570720.short_description: Explore the anime-style open world of the Continent of Orbis, brought to life with Unreal Engine 5! Recruit unique companions, unleash spectacular Status Ailment tag-team action, and embark on an epic journey to save the world from the threat of a Dragon reawakened after 60 years.

3743260.name: Virtue and a Sledgehammer
3743260.short_description: Go back to your hometown and tear it down with a sledgehammer in this narrative exploration game. Confront your past in a devastating story about feeling like you no longer belong in the place you grew up.

3259780.name: FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE
3259780.short_description: Return to the pixel‑art world of FINAL FANTASY, evolved from its classic roots. Travel with companions bound by fate and call on Visions to aid you in battle to uncover the truth behind a force that threatens to bring everything to ruin.

3939100.name: Insomnia: Chapter One
3939100.short_description: 2012. The Arctic research station "Persei" loses contact with the outside world. You are Ethan Miller, a technician sent to the facility to fix the issues. But something here has clearly gone out of control.

4262620.name: The Alighieri Circle: Dante's Bloodline
4262620.short_description: The world knows the Divine Comedy as a poem. For your family, it is a prison. As Gabriele Alighieri, you inherit a duty: reseal the gates of Hell. Burdened by fate, you descend into a psychological nightmare where the only escape is to uncover the dark secrets of your ancestors.

1962950.name: The Green Light
1962950.short_description: A first person horror game. Fred is stuck in a dead-end job, haunted by hallucinations. A voice on the radio speaks of a green light. It promises peace and freedom. A tale of self-discovery where Fred is willing to find freedom, even at the cost of his life.

4441710.name: Staged: Open House
4441710.short_description: In this first-person psychological horror, you are Frank Doyle, a professional home stager hired to prepare a vacant house for sale. The Ward family vanished months ago, leaving everything behind. At first, your job seems easy, but the house isn't as empty as it seems.

4323990.name: EMPULSE
4323990.short_description: EMPULSE is a fast-paced 6v6 movement shooter. Wall-run, grapple, Holojump, pilot mechs, and P.A.I.N.T. your way through Freehold's vertical streets. Outmove your opponent or get outgunned.

3330890.name: Shiver
3330890.short_description: A survival horror game where reality itself seems to unravel as you navigate the frozen hellscape to find your missing sister – defending yourself from horrors beyond our understanding, and nature itself. Solve puzzles, combat ice-covered nightmares, and most importantly, survive.

4810650.name: Black Tides Draga's Wake
4810650.short_description: Stranded on a nightmare colossal steamship in an alternate 1900s, unleash visceral brawler combat against twisted horrors below deck. Regroup your scattered crew and uncover what’s awakening inside the hull. Confront-Absorb-Survive

3509160.name: BAIONLENJA
3509160.short_description: First-Person Adventure that focuses on Source-Engine inspired movement physics. Explore an impossibly huge research facility using physics-breaking abilities granted by a mysterious fossil monolith. Evolve to reach new areas and fight strange machines roaming the laboratories.

1116390.name: Negative Atmosphere
1116390.short_description: Explore the depths of the Rusanov, pull whatever resources you can out of its guts, and run.

4171670.name: Veil of Mist
4171670.short_description: Life ends… but the story doesn’t. After death, you find yourself in a strange, distorted place where normal logic no longer applies. Explore, hide, solve puzzles, and try to figure out exactly where you’ve ended up.

4148910.name: Wasabi
4148910.short_description: Every day, a new corpse turns up in this quiet town. Every day, a new suspect emerges. And every day, that cave looms larger, more ominously. Amidst gory crime scenes and suffocating interrogations, only one thing will lead you to the truth: wasabi.

3846900.name: Sword Sage: Awakening
3846900.short_description: Sword Sage: Awakening is an action RPG rooted in Chinese myth and folklore. You play as Pei Sanniang, a novice disciple of the Yuangong Sect, about to confront the thousand-year inherited burden by the leaking of the forbidden celestial books, and the many ominous forces lurking in the shadows...

4863030.name: Naomi’s End
4863030.short_description: Naomi wakes decades older in a house she does not recognize, and discovers that escape may cost the future.

4457050.name: Remothered: Tormented Fathers Remastered
4457050.short_description: The first chapter of the modern old school survival horror saga, rebuilt in Unreal Engine 5. Same ruthless tension, sharper everything.

4461560.name: Remothered: Broken Porcelain Remastered
4461560.short_description: The second chapter of the iconic modern old school survival horror saga. Remastered in Unreal Engine 5 to deliver a dramatically improved experience, while keeping every mechanic, every scare, and every secret exactly as they were.

3949040.name: RV There Yet?
3949040.short_description: A co-op adventure about driving your Recreational Vehicle home.

4704690.name: MECCHA CHAMELEON
4704690.short_description: Paint yourself to blend in! "Meccha Chameleon" is a new-sensation hide-and-seek game where you paint your white body to mimic the stage. Spot, pose, and "artistic skill" are keys to survival. Deceive Seekers with techniques that put chameleons to shame! Supports public matches and streaming.

3211430.name: BRIGANDINE ABYSS
3211430.short_description: Play as one of six factions to confront the Abyssloa Empire. Command your troops, develop your bases, and take control of the continent of Meltitea in this tactical strategy RPG!

4022950.name: Nature of Dread
4022950.short_description: A gritty first-person action-horror where you awaken trapped in the cursed settlement of Hellhole—a forsaken place swallowed by the northern wilderness. Fight your way out of this nightmare’s depths and uncover what has been buried under top-secret clearance for centuries.

3290710.name: RATSHAKER™
3290710.short_description: RATSHAKER™ is the fun and quirky solution to all your rat problems! Hold on to the RAT, shake your arm, and watch life’s problems disappear! How far can you go?

1910860.name: Grimlord
1910860.short_description: Grimlord is a Dark Fantasy Action Souls-like RPG - on VR. Awakened in a monastery deep in the Lonely Mountains, you walk in an epic quest as the adventurer standing before the darkness and striving for the light against the tyrannical Grim Lord.

3936520.name: Tour de France 2026
3936520.short_description: Take on the best international cyclists with one goal in mind: winning the 2026 Tour de France. Conquer legendary mountain passes, launch your sprints at the perfect moment and emerge triumphant on the Champs-Élysées wearing the Yellow Jersey.

4538140.name: Rehaunted
4538140.short_description: Enter a house where every clue feels wrong. Investigate a brutal crime scene, uncover hidden evidence, and use your detective tools to piece together a disturbing truth buried beneath the silence.

2906500.name: The Thing That Happened
2906500.short_description: Thing That Happened is an Openworld Third Person - Action Adventure Survial game. You can use multiple weapons, attachments, close combat skills tree's and crafting to break through your enemies.

3282300.name: Mistfall Hunter
3282300.short_description: Mistfall Hunter is a dark fantasy extraction ARPG. Combine skills, talents, and gear for each class in thrilling combat! Whether you team up or go solo, one thing remains certain—only by fighting your way through can you return with a full haul. Good luck, Gyldhunter.

4038610.name: The Eventide
4038610.short_description: A supernatural mystery where perspective informs reality. Guide agents from the Eventide Agency through paranormal investigations across a neon-soaked cityscape. Explore, collect clues, and interpret the evidence to uncover the facts of each case and expose a deeper truth.

5219090.name: ELYSIUM
5219090.short_description: ELYSIUM is a next-gen third-person MMORPG forged by Mercenary Games. Explore a living open world, AI companions & step into realm Full Sandbox Roleplay (RP) with a living economy Free to play with built-in purchases and a self-contained in-game economy — your progression, your ecosystem, your story!

3851090.name: Grobnopolis | Last Days
3851090.short_description: Grobnopolis is a slow, oppressive atmospheric horror experience where curiosity is both compass and curse. The sun is gone. The mines are bleeding. Walk the dying city of Huta-Grobno, tune into forbidden broadcasts and survive the last days of a world rotting under the clouds.

2776540.name: Opaldune
2776540.short_description: A scifi third person survival horror. Stranded in the farthest reaches of space, Dr. Belica Gale boards the Opaldune seeking help. But in the bowels of the ship, monsters are prowling. Slip through dark hallways to scavenge for supplies, solve puzzles, and evade enemies long enough to get back out.

2326200.name: NEO BERLIN 2087
2326200.short_description: Uncover the truth as Nolan, a troubled detective chasing a conspiracy shaking the foundation of Neo Berlin: a cyberpunk city split in two by technology, wealth, and class.

3905450.name: WheelMates
3905450.short_description: Dive into a 2-player co-op driving adventure with RC cars. Explore the professor’s home laboratory, solve puzzles, find hidden paths, and uncover what happened inside. With Friend’s Pass, your friend joins for free.

2840000.name: Lumina Veil
2840000.short_description: Lumina Veil, a horror game with a modern twist! Step into the shoes of a popular streamer on a journey into a strange new game. As you dive deeper, you'll find yourself escaping the isolation of your own world, only to discover that the lines between fantasy and reality are beginning to blur.

3743180.name: Dire Echo
3743180.short_description: Dire Echo is a psychological horror walking simulator that immerses players in the eerie and oppressive atmosphere of abandoned deep space.

5067360.name: Thank You Bus Driver
5067360.short_description: Take on the role of a town’s rules-driven (and reckless) bus driver in Thank You Bus Driver! Drive fast, slap faster, and toss any rulebreakers out of your bus to reach true victory: being appreciated.

3436970.name: Mournight
3436970.short_description: A terrifying 1–4 player co-op horror game set in a cursed mansion. Use flashlights, find clues, and survive the horrors within. Every decision matters. Can you escape before the curse claims you?

4432150.name: Soulstonia
4432150.short_description: Recruit Summoners with minds of their own in this cozy idle RPG. Set idle goals and let your party gather, craft, and fight for you, or take control anytime. Train 20+ skills, summon creatures, and explore a living fantasy world. Free-to-play at launch.

4810160.name: DABA Land of Water Scar
4810160.short_description: Clayman, the world in your hands. God, savior, or destroyer. Choose, and pay the price.

4829820.name: Alkimya: House of Wisdom
4829820.short_description: A first-person survival horror game set in the House of Wisdom during the 1258 siege of Baghdad. Scavenge for resources, craft alchemical flasks, unlock an interconnected sanctum of Golden Age puzzles, and survive the Mongol invaders — and the cosmic horror waiting beneath them.

2902170.name: Kernel Hearts
2902170.short_description: Gather your allies. Eliminate Angels. Transform into a Magical Girl. Slay god. Kernel Hearts is a Multiplayer Co-Op Roguelike Action RPG about four magical girls and their attempt to save a world that's drowning in ashes

3393110.name: AION 2
3393110.short_description: AION 2 is the only MMORPG built around a world where the sky is the battlefield. Choose your faction, ascend as a Daeva, and fight a faction war across a world 36 times larger than the original. PC only, on Unreal Engine 5.

3882410.name: Qliphah in Providence's Shadow
3882410.short_description: Tokyo has fallen. In the wake of the 'Collapse,' time is your ultimate weapon. Unleash real-time skills, predict enemy moves, and deliver devastating counters in this high-stakes Tactical Timeline RPG.

1949610.name: Luminous Nights
1949610.short_description: Embark on a HeartsLike action-RPG inspired by 1001 Arabian Nights. Master fast-paced melee combat and powerful magic, unlock new abilities and weapons, explore the mystical city of Noor through 3D platforming, and rally memorable allies against the Masked King.

2938460.name: Police Chief Simulator
2938460.short_description: Welcome to Winston Springs, Officer! The local police station is in urgent need of a Chief of Police, and you’ve been chosen for the job! Handle incoming reports, renovate and expand the station, solve cases, and fight crime!

2659410.name: Elta: Defy All Gods
2659410.short_description: Brawl your way out of corrupted worlds alongside your dragon-god companion in an adrenaline-fueled action-platformer blending free-form melee combat, fluid platforming and sci-fi exploration. Become the champion of your fallen god, Elta.

3096000.name: Last Half of Darkness
3096000.short_description: Your aunt sure was a strange one. She was some sort of witch or something. A good witch though, practicing only good spells and magic. In fact, she was working on a potion just before she was killed. Now the secret will go to the grave with her... unless you can find the missing ingredients.

2688780.name: Odd Town
2688780.short_description: Odd Town is a story-driven first-person adventure about being stuck in a town where everything feels just a little wrong. Explore a handcrafted, bite-sized town, meet suspicious locals, take odd jobs, dodge cops, become a conspiracy theorist, and steal sandwiches.

4928600.name: Black Lake
4928600.short_description: Black Lake is a first-person survival horror game set in an abandoned orphanage beside an endless black ocean. Search for your missing sister, survive what the children became, and uncover the ritual beneath the lake.

5396900.name: The Unfinished Horror Game
5396900.short_description: You wake up inside a horror game that was never finished. Glitches everywhere, monsters that ignore their code, and an old man who says he wants to help. Find the key, survive the house and get out alive.

4119440.name: Sker: The Bleeding Veil
4119440.short_description: Evade Sister Gwenllian and her ritual-bound orphans as you use sound to explore, solve harmonic puzzles and survive blind stalkers that hunt by hearing. Sker: The Bleeding Veil is a first-person, stealth-focused survival horror set in the Sker universe.

3348610.name: Encryption
3348610.short_description: Encryption is a cinematic first-person psychological horror adventure set during a climate catastrophe burning through southern Italy. A father searches for his missing daughter in Matera, one of the oldest inhabited places on Earth, now evacuated, while something awaits in the darkness below.

1751730.name: FIRE AND ASHES
1751730.short_description: You wake up in a terrifying psychiatric hospital. Fire and Ashes is an immersive horror game where madness and reality blur, and every monster hears your scream… even beyond the hospital walls.

2826400.name: CASE RECORDS: Fear of Abduction
2826400.short_description: Psychological horror, which is part of the games CASE: Animatronics and CASE 2: Animatronics Survival.

3520330.name: CASE RECORDS: Lost Night
3520330.short_description: CASE RECORDS is short a series of psychological horror games that are part of the CASE: Animatronics.

2999120.name: Retrieval
2999120.short_description: Experience Retrieval, a PlayStation® award-winning horror adventure. Join Hana Loshe on a perilous journey into darkness, uncovering secrets and facing its deep drama story full of terrifying challenges on the distant planet Ryhalian
